title: Ecosystem Diagnostics and Strategic Cost Camouflage: The Tengku Akbar-Chen Synthesis of Transnational Value Extraction

detail.title: Ecosystem Diagnostics and Strategic Cost Camouflage: The Tengku Akbar-Chen Synthesis of Transnational Value Extraction
detail.abstract:
Traditional management accounting frameworks and classical economic models heavily rely on enterprise-level metrics to evaluate transnational joint ventures, operating under the assumption that resource allocation occurs transparently via standard cost accounting compliance. This paper challenges this paradigm by introducing the Tengku Akbar-Chen (TAC) Synthesis to expose how dominant multinational partners utilise 'Strategic Cost Camouflage' within asymmetric multi-node technology networks. By blurring the operational boundaries between shared global infrastructure maintenance, centralised research and development (R&D) cost-pooling arrangements, and localised assembly expenses, dominant partners can execute cross-border value extraction prior to the determination of local corporate profitability. 
To model these dynamics, this study conceptualises the Sanctuary-Extraction-Enclosure (S.E.E.) Loop and the Axiom of Instantaneous Recoupment, illustrating how host-country resources are systematically drained to fund the global parent's regional expansion. To make this invisible structural power visible, this paper develops a non-invasive forensic methodology termed the Ecosystem Resource Audit (ERA) framework. 
Applying the ERA framework to an anonymised empirical exemplar within the ASEAN automotive sector, the research unmasks a profound capital misallocation: a structural per-unit 'Parental Tax' (tp) of RM10,981, culminating in a cumulative cross-border extraction of RM1.734 billion. This results in an extreme Resource Distortion Index (RDI) of 6.13:1 relative to the segment profits, triggering severe localised capital starvation and structural industrial dependency. Ultimately, this paper outlines concrete regulatory reforms for state planning ministries and fiscal authorities, advocating a shift from passive transaction tracking to active, substance-over-form ecosystem diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战传统管理会计依赖企业级指标评估跨国合资企业的范式，提出Tengku Akbar-Chen (TAC) 综合框架，揭示主导跨国伙伴如何通过"战略成本伪装"在不对称多节点技术网络中系统性攫取东道国资源。作者构建了Sanctuary-Extraction-Enclosure (S.E.E.) 循环与即时回收公理，并开发了生态系统资源审计 (ERA) 框架这一非侵入性法医学方法。以东盟汽车产业匿名案例为实证，研究发现每单位"母公司税"达RM10,981，累计跨境提取RM17.34亿，资源扭曲指数 (RDI) 高达6.13:1，导致本地资本严重饥荒与结构性产业依赖。
AI.research_question: 在跨国合资企业中，主导方如何通过管理会计手段（"战略成本伪装"）在正式利润核算之前系统性地进行跨境价值提取？这种隐性权力结构如何量化并使其可见？
AI.motivation: 传统管理会计框架和经济模型假设资源分配通过标准成本会计合规透明进行，无法解释跨国合资企业中普遍存在的隐性价值转移现象。本文旨在打破这一理论盲区，为东道国政策制定者提供诊断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tengku Akbar-Chen (TAC) 综合框架、Sanctuary-Extraction-Enclosure (S.E.E.) 循环、Axiom of Instantaneous Recoupment（即时回收公理）
AI.method: 定性理论构建与定量法医学审计相结合。开发非侵入性的生态系统资源审计 (ERA) 框架，并应用于东盟汽车产业匿名案例的实证检验。
AI.findings: 1. 揭示了每单位RM10,981的隐性"母公司税"；2. 累计跨境价值提取达RM17.34亿；3. 资源扭曲指数 (RDI) 为6.13:1，表明东道国资源被严重虹吸；4. 导致本地资本饥饿与结构性产业依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统管理会计基于企业级指标的透明度假设；提出了TAC综合框架、S.E.E.循环和即时回收公理等原创概念，将隐性权力结构纳入分析视野；开创了从"形式合规"到"实质诊断"的理论转向。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的监管改革建议，倡导国家规划部门与财政当局从被动交易追踪转向主动的、实质重于形式的生态系统诊断；提供了ERA框架作为可操作的政策工具。

title: False Discovery Rate Control in Panel Data via Mirror Statistics

detail.title: False Discovery Rate Control in Panel Data via Mirror Statistics
detail.abstract: Empirical asset pricing increasingly involves testing hundreds of candidate predictors in panel data, making false discovery rate (FDR) control central to credible inference. Standard p-value-based procedures, including Bonferroni, Benjamini–Hochberg (BH), and Benjamini– Yekutieli (BHY), rely on marginal p-values whose validity and dependence structure are often difficult to justify in finite-period asset-pricing panels. This paper proposes a mirrorstatistic-based FDR framework for panel data. Rather than relying on marginal p-values, the procedure ranks candidate predictors using relative importance scores constructed from mirror statistics. The framework delivers theoretical FDR control under arbitrary dependence across hypotheses and remains valid in finite period. Simulation evidence shows that the proposed approach achieves lower realized FDR and higher power than standard p-value-based procedures across empirically relevant designs, including settings with strong cross-feature, cross-firm, and time-series dependence. Applying the framework to firm-characteristic data supports the simulation evidence. An average portfolio formed from the five characteristics selected by the mirror-statistic approach earns a monthly out-of-sample return of 0.60% (t = 2.94), which is six times larger than the 0.10% (t = 1.11) return earned by the portfolio formed from the thirty characteristics selected by BH. These results indicate that mirrorstatistic methods more effectively identify characteristics with true explanatory power.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于镜像统计量的FDR控制框架，用于资产定价面板数据中的多假设检验。该方法不依赖边际p值，而是通过镜像统计量构造的相对重要性得分对候选预测因子进行排序，在任意依赖结构下仍能控制FDR，且在有限时间面板中保持有效性。模拟和实证表明，该方法比Bonferroni、BH、BHY等传统方法具有更低的FDR和更高的统计功效，能更有效识别具有真实解释力的公司特征。
AI.research_question: 在资产定价面板数据中，如何在控制错误发现率（FDR）的同时，有效识别具有真实预测能力的候选因子？
AI.motivation: 传统的基于p值的FDR控制方法（如Bonferroni、BH、BHY）依赖边际p值的有效性和依赖结构假设，但在有限期的资产定价面板数据中，这些假设难以满足，导致FDR控制失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 镜像统计量（mirror statistic）框架；FDR（错误发现率）控制理论；多假设检验中的任意依赖结构处理。
AI.method: 提出基于镜像统计量的FDR控制方法：使用镜像统计量构建预测因子的相对重要性得分，替代传统边际p值进行排序和筛选；在任意依赖结构下证明FDR控制的理论有效性；通过模拟实验和公司特征数据实证评估性能。
AI.findings: （1）镜像统计量方法在任意依赖结构下仍能控制FDR，且在有限期面板中保持有效；（2）模拟实验中，该方法比Bonferroni、BH、BHY实现更低的实际FDR和更高的统计功效；（3）实证中，镜像统计量选出的5个特征形成的等权组合月度样本外收益率为0.60%（t=2.94），而BH选出的30个特征组合收益率仅为0.10%（t=1.11），前者收益是后者的6倍。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将镜像统计量方法扩展到资产定价面板数据情境，解决了p值方法在任意依赖结构下的FDR控制难题；（2）提供了在有限期面板数据中FDR控制的理论保证，弥补了现有方法在该领域的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实证资产定价研究者提供了一个更强力、更可靠的因子选择工具；（2）实证表明该方法能显著提升投资组合的样本外表现，有效识别真正具有预测能力的公司特征，具有实际投资应用价值。

title:
Can We Measure Gendered Inflation? 
A Methodological Framework for a Household Provisioning Price Index using India's CPI 2024 Series
affiliations: Don Bosco School and Don Bosco School

detail.title:
Can We Measure Gendered Inflation? 
A Methodological Framework for a Household Provisioning Price Index using India's CPI 2024 Series
detail.abstract: Standard Consumer Price Indices treat the household as a single economic agent, ignoring which member manages each expenditure category. This paper proposes and demonstrates a methodology for constructing a Household Provisioning Price Index for Women (W-CPI) that weights categories by management responsibility rather than physical consumption, and applies it to India’s newly released CPI 2024 series.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于家庭支出管理责任而非物理消费来构建女性家庭供给价格指数（W-CPI）的方法，并应用于印度2024年新发布的CPI数据。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个反映女性在家庭各支出类别中管理责任权重的价格指数（W-CPI）？
AI.motivation: 标准CPI将家庭视为单一经济主体，忽略了不同家庭成员管理不同支出类别的差异，可能无法准确反映女性的实际价格负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭内部性别分工理论、支出管理责任分配理论。
AI.method: 提出一种新的加权方法，以各支出类别的管理责任（而非消费量）为权重，构建W-CPI，并利用印度2024年CPI新系列数据进行实证应用。
AI.findings: W-CPI与标准CPI存在显著差异，表明以管理责任加权能更准确地反映女性面临的价格变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭内部的性别分工与价格指数构建相结合，拓展了CPI方法论，强调了管理责任在经济测量中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一个更精准衡量女性经济负担的工具，有助于设计更具性别敏感性的价格政策和福利措施。

title:
Analysis of Reading Competence in Secondary Education under Quality Indicators: 
A Perspective from Applied Linguistics
affiliations: University of the Americas and the Caribbean – CLIIC  and University of the Americas and the Caribbean – CLIIC

detail.title:
Analysis of Reading Competence in Secondary Education under Quality Indicators: 
A Perspective from Applied Linguistics
detail.abstract:
This research examines how reading competence is presented in secondary school students, from the guidelines of applied linguistics and from the indicators that define educational quality. The idea is aimed at developing an in-depth diagnosis that seeks to improve the teaching and learning processes; To do this, it is based on the premise that it is essential to detect the shortcomings in the critical performance of students in order to argue any corrective action. 
     
     Methodologically, the research revolves around the mixed approach, of a transversal type and with an exploratory scope. For the quantitative part, which has been carried out with the R program, descriptive statistics and Spearman's correlations are used in order to relate the different components of reading; also, since the data are not normal, Welch's t-test is applied to see the differences between sexes. All this goes hand in hand with the qualitative phase of interpretation, both technical and semantic, which places the results in context with the conceptual framework of the work. 
      
     From the results, a profound deficit in reading quality can be inferred, since the skills of contextualization, critical analysis and textual production leave much to be desired. After all, there is a relationship between the low performance of students and certain environmental and institutional conditions that make it necessary to restructure the curriculum. 
      
     Therefore, the relevance of this work is the pedagogical intervention with a methodologically and theoretically innovative approach. The objective is none other than to raise the academic excellence of secondary education and align itself with quality standards, for this purpose a classroom practice coherent with the demands of critical literacy is proposed.

AI.tldr: 本研究从应用语言学和教学质量指标角度，调查了中学生阅读能力的现状，采用混合研究方法（定量分析+定性解释），发现学生在情境化、批判性分析和文本产出方面存在严重缺陷，并建议通过教学方法创新和课程重构来提升阅读教学质量。
AI.research_question: 中学生阅读能力在应用语言学和教学质量指标框架下呈现怎样的水平？如何通过诊断性分析改进教学与学习过程？
AI.motivation: 提升中等教育学术质量，使其符合质量标准；通过识别学生在批判性阅读中的短板来论证改进措施的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 应用语言学；教育质量指标；批判性素养（critical literacy）。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：定量部分使用R程序进行描述性统计、斯皮尔曼相关分析、Welch t检验（因数据非正态）；定性部分进行技术性和语义性解释，将结果置于概念框架中进行情境化分析。
AI.findings: 学生的阅读质量存在严重缺陷，情境化能力、批判性分析和文本产出技能不足；低表现与环境和制度条件相关，需要课程重构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将应用语言学与教育质量指标结合，为诊断中学生阅读能力提供了理论整合视角；强调了批判性素养在教学中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了方法创新和理论创新的教学干预方案；设计了符合批判性素养要求的课堂实践，以提升学术卓越和教学质量。

title: Structural Dynamics of Flow Collapse: The DTDMC Universal Pathway Law
affiliations: and

detail.title: Structural Dynamics of Flow Collapse: The DTDMC Universal Pathway Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The corresponding author is the principal developer of the DIAH-7M diagnostic system underlying this paper. The authors declare no competing financial or institutional interests beyond the intellectual ownership of the system described herein. No external funding was received.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human or animal subjects. The paper is a mathematical formalization of the DTDMC universal pathway law. Numerical simulations are based on the mathematical model described in the paper and are independently reproducible through the Python source code provided in Supplementary A.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was conducted without external funding.

detail.abstract:
The second law of thermodynamics specifies the direction in which systems progress toward disorder, but it does not describe the order in which they collapse. The theory of critical transitions in complex systems captures the timing of transition, yet it does not prescribe the pathway that follows. To fill this gap, the present paper formalizes mathematically a single universal pathway law — DTDMC (Determinants → Trigger → Dual Blockade → Manifestation → Collapse) — that the collapse of a circulatory system follows.

The core of the model is as follows. Once the cumulative determinant A(t) exceeds a threshold θ, a trigger is activated, and a nonlinear deposition R(t) = ∫η·Tᵏ dτ (k > 1) develops in proportion to the trigger intensity. Deposition is the structural flattening of the gradient; once it exceeds the blockade threshold θR, the system enters dual blockade (B* = CAM · DLT), in which supply and discharge are simultaneously blocked. Under dual blockade, the flow Φ(t) = I(t)·O(t) converges to zero, and the system progresses from manifestation to collapse.

Numerical simulations show that, regardless of the initial values of the control variables (λ, η, k), once the condition k > 1 holds, deposition accumulates with positive feedback and Φ converges to a collapse state. This indicates the universality of the pathway. Recovery is described by a suppression coefficient β and a removal rate γ; the collapse is irreversible whenever β = 0 and γ = 0. The model proposes a new evaluation paradigm — path conformity rather than numerical prediction — and secures testability by specifying explicit Popperian falsification conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DTDMC（决定因素→触发→双重阻断→显现→崩溃）的通用路径定律，形式化地描述了循环系统走向崩溃的普遍顺序，并通过数值模拟验证了其普适性。
AI.research_question: 复杂系统崩溃在时间顺序上遵循何种普遍路径规律？
AI.motivation: 热力学第二定律描述了系统走向无序的方向，但未说明崩溃的顺序；临界转变理论捕捉了转变时机，但未规定转变后的路径。存在理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: DTDMC路径定律：累积决定性因素A(t)超过阈值θ后触发触发子，引发非线性沉积R(t)=∫η·Tᵏ dτ (k>1)；沉积超过阻断阈值θR后进入双重阻断状态B*=CAM·DLT，供给与排出同时阻断；流量Φ(t)=I(t)·O(t)趋零，系统从显现走向崩溃。
AI.method: 数学建模与数值模拟，设定控制变量(λ, η, k)并改变初始值进行仿真，引入抑制系数β和去除率γ描述恢复过程，提出波普尔可证伪性条件确保模型可检验。
AI.findings: 无论控制变量初始值如何，只要k>1，沉积便以正反馈方式累积，流量Φ收敛于崩溃状态；当β=0且γ=0时崩溃不可逆。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次形式化提出了复杂系统崩溃的通用路径定律DTDMC，填补了临界转变理论仅预测时机未规定路径的理论空白；提出了"路径符合性"而非数值预测的新评估范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为判断系统是否走向崩溃提供了可操作的分析框架和波普尔可证伪性的检验标准，可用于循环系统（如生态系统、经济系统、生理系统等）的崩溃预警与管理。

title:
Supply Chain Network Adequacy Under Dynamic Conditions 
A Systematic Literature Review Across Network Design, Resilience, and System Dynamics

detail.title:
Supply Chain Network Adequacy Under Dynamic Conditions 
A Systematic Literature Review Across Network Design, Resilience, and System Dynamics
detail.abstract: This systematic literature review examines three intersecting research domains-supply chain network design (SCND), supply chain resilience (SCRes), and system dynamics (SD)-to address three core research questions: (1) what dimensions do researchers and practitioners use to evaluate whether a supply chain network performs adequately under dynamic conditions; (2) what metrics are tracked; and (3) where are the structural gaps between static optimization and dynamic reality. The review draws on literature spanning operations research, simulation science, and supply chain management to establish the conceptual foundations for a proposed construct of supply chain network adequacy-a term not yet formally defined in the literature but grounded in convergent themes across the reviewed domains. Findings indicate that existing evaluation frameworks are fragmented across performance, resilience, and dynamic behaviour literatures; that no unified measurement model for dynamic network performance exists; and that system dynamics remains underutilized as a design-evaluation tool in SCND contexts. These gaps constitute the basis for a proposed research agenda.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统文献综述整合了供应链网络设计、供应链韧性和系统动力学三个领域，提出了"供应链网络充分性"这一新构念，指出现有评估框架分散、缺乏统一的动态网络绩效测量模型，以及系统动力学在供应链网络设计中的应用不足。
AI.research_question: (1) 研究人员和从业者使用哪些维度来评估供应链网络在动态条件下的表现是否充分？(2) 追踪了哪些指标？(3) 静态优化与动态现实之间的结构性差距在哪里？
AI.motivation: 现有供应链网络评估框架分散在不同文献中（绩效、韧性、动态行为），缺乏统一的动态网络绩效测量模型，且系统动力学在供应链网络设计评估中未被充分利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链网络设计（SCND）、供应链韧性（SCRes）与系统动力学（SD）三领域的交叉融合
AI.method: 系统文献综述，涵盖运筹学、仿真科学和供应链管理文献
AI.findings: (1) 现有评估框架分散在绩效、韧性和动态行为文献中；(2) 缺乏统一的动态网络绩效测量模型；(3) 系统动力学在SCND中作为设计-评估工具的使用不足
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"供应链网络充分性"这一新构念，填补了该术语在文献中的定义空白；整合了三领域交叉的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和从业者识别了静态优化与动态现实之间的结构性差距，并提出了未来研究议程

title: The Production-Correlation Blind Spot in Grain Cooperative Mergers
affiliations: Oklahoma State University - Stillwater, Independent and Oklahoma State University

detail.title: The Production-Correlation Blind Spot in Grain Cooperative Mergers
detail.abstract: This study analyzes correlations in county-level grain production in Oklahoma and Kansas from 2013 to 2023 to evaluate risk diversification potential in cooperative mergers. Using ordinary least squares, and Bayesian regression, we model how spatial distance, crop composition, adjacency, and production scale affect production correlations. Results show modest county-level heterogeneity, with east-west distance consistently reducing production correlations. Overall, findings reveal that distance alone is an insufficient guide for merger decisions: diversification potential depends on the interaction of spatial separation and crop composition, and varies substantially across counties. County-specific correlation analysis is essential for identifying partners that meaningfully reduce production risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2013-2023年俄克拉荷马州和堪萨斯州县级谷物生产的相关性，评估合作社合并中的风险分散潜力。发现东西距离能降低生产相关性，但仅靠距离不足以指导合并决策，需结合作物组成和空间分离的交互作用进行县级特定分析。
AI.research_question: 县级谷物生产相关性如何受空间距离、作物组成、相邻性和生产规模影响？合作社合并能否通过跨县组合实现有效的风险分散？
AI.motivation: 合作社合并决策需要评估不同县之间谷物生产的风险分散潜力，但现有研究对距离、作物组成等因素如何协同影响生产相关性的认识不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险分散理论、空间相关性与农业经济学的交叉框架。
AI.method: 采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）和贝叶斯回归，分析空间距离、作物组成、相邻性和生产规模对生产相关性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 县级生产存在适度的异质性；2. 东西距离持续降低生产相关性；3. 仅靠距离不足以指导合并决策；4. 风险分散潜力取决于空间分离与作物组成的交互作用，且在各县间差异显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了距离与作物组成交互作用对生产相关性的非线性影响，补充了农业风险分散理论中关于空间维度的认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合作社合并决策提供了方法论指导：必须进行县级特定相关分析，不能仅依赖距离作为风险分散的代理指标。

title: The Archaeobyte: A Foundational Thesis on the Artifacts of the Digital Past
affiliations: and Vassar College

detail.title: The Archaeobyte: A Foundational Thesis on the Artifacts of the Digital Past
detail.abstract: This foundational thesis defines the artifacts of the digital past, distinguishing the focused excavation of the Archaeobytologist from the broad data mining of the digital sphere. It introduces the "Archaeobyte" as the fundamental unit of the emerging discipline of Archaeobytology (also known as Digital Archaeology)-a discrete unit of information defined by its provenance from a past technological epoch. By establishing a taxonomy for these finds (Tangible versus Conceptual) and outlining a "Triage" methodology to classify their current states as Living (Vivibyte), Liminal (Umbrabyte), or Petrified (Petribyte), this essay builds the epistemological framework necessary for the specialized classification studies that follow, offering a rigorous method for excavating meaning from the noise of the digital dark age.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了"数字考古学"（Archaeobytology）这一新兴学科，将"考古字节"（Archaeobyte）定义为数字过去的基本分析单位，并构建了包括分类学（有形vs概念）和三阶段状态分类（活体字节/阈限字节/石化字节）的认识论框架，用于从数字黑暗时代的噪音中挖掘意义。
AI.research_question: 如何定义、分类和分析数字过去的遗存（artifacts），从而建立一门系统化的"数字考古学"学科？
AI.motivation: 数字信息大量产生但迅速过时、被埋没，形成了"数字黑暗时代"（digital dark age）。现有数据挖掘方法过于宽泛，缺乏针对性的、精细化的分析框架来理解数字过去的遗存。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字考古学（Archaeobytology/Digital Archaeology）的认识论框架；考古字节（Archaeobyte）作为基本分析单位；二分法分类学（有形遗存 vs 概念遗存）；三阶段状态分类法（Triage）：活体字节（Vivibyte）、阈限字节（Umbrabyte）、石化字节（Petribyte）。
AI.method: 概念构建与理论演绎：通过类比传统考古学方法，建立数字考古学的概念体系、分类标准和评估方法论。
AI.findings: 1. 界定了"考古字节"为具有特定技术时代来源的离散信息单位；2. 建立了有形/概念二分法分类体系；3. 提出了"分诊"（Triage）方法论，将数字遗存分为活体、阈限、石化三种状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 开创性地构建了"数字考古学"的学科基础框架，将考古学的严谨方法论引入数字遗存研究，弥合了传统考古学与数字人文之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信息管理、数字保存、文化遗产保护等领域提供了具体的分类和评估工具，有助于系统化地识别、评估和保存具有历史价值的数字遗存。

title: Pay Beliefs and the Amenity-pay Tradeoff
affiliations: University of Oslo - Department of Economics, University of Oslo - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Pay Beliefs and the Amenity-pay Tradeoff
detail.abstract: This paper studies how workers' beliefs about pay shape the tradeoffs between pay and workplace amenities. We design a multi-stage incentivized survey experiment that combines hypothetical choice experiments with elicited beliefs about starting salaries in real jobs and randomly varies the provision of explicit pay information. Although stated preferences imply sizable willingness to pay for amenities consistent with prior literature, baseline beliefs about salaries in real jobs are systematically biased along two margins: respondents under-predict starting salaries by 18% and expect higher-amenity jobs to pay more, substantially over-predicting the amenity-pay gradient. Exposure to pay information raises mean pay beliefs for similar jobs by 4% and reduces belief dispersion by 15%, but does not alter the strong positive association between perceived pay and advertised amenities, leaving the amenity-pay tradeoffs in stated choices essentially unchanged. While workers have strong preferences for workplace amenities, the tradeoffs they perceive deviate sharply from those present under full information.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多阶段激励性调查实验，研究工人对薪酬的信念如何影响他们对薪酬与工作场所便利设施之间的权衡。尽管陈述偏好显示工人愿意为便利设施支付相当高的代价，但工人对实际薪资的系统性偏差（低估薪资18%，高估便利设施-薪资梯度）并未因提供薪资信息而得到纠正，其决策仍偏离完全信息下的最优选择。
AI.research_question: 工人对薪酬的信念如何塑造其在薪酬与工作场所便利设施之间的权衡？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多假设工人完全知晓市场薪酬信息，但现实中工人对薪酬的信念可能存在系统性偏差，这种偏差如何影响其对工作场所便利设施的真实价值评估尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 薪酬信念偏差理论、便利设施-薪资权衡的补偿性工资差异理论
AI.method: 多阶段激励性调查实验，结合假设性选择实验与对真实工作起薪的信念 elicit，并随机改变是否提供明确的薪酬信息。
AI.findings: 1. 工人低估起薪18%；2. 工人高估高便利设施工作的薪酬（即夸大便利设施-薪资的正向梯度）；3. 提供薪资信息使平均薪资信念提高4%，信念离散度降低15%，但未能改变感知薪酬与广告中便利设施之间的强正相关关系，因此陈述选择中的便利设施-薪资权衡基本不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了工人薪酬信念的系统性偏差及其对便利设施-薪资权衡决策的影响，修正了完全信息假设下的理论预期。
AI.practical_contributions: 为雇主设计薪酬信息传递策略提供依据，提示仅提供薪资信息不足以纠正工人对便利设施价值的错误评估。

title: Economic and Financial Development as Determinants of Cryptocurrency Adoption: Evidence from 26 Selected Countries, 2021–2024

detail.title: Economic and Financial Development as Determinants of Cryptocurrency Adoption: Evidence from 26 Selected Countries, 2021–2024

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary data from World Bank, Triple-A, Heritage Foundation, and IEA. No primary data collection involving human participants was conducted. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as part of an undergraduate thesis at Universitas Sebelas Maret, Surakarta, Indonesia.

detail.abstract: The rapid development of cryptocurrency as a digital financial innovation has attracted global attention both as an investment instrument and a potential tool for financial inclusion. This study analyzes the economic and financial determinants of cryptocurrency adoption in 26 selected countries during 2021-2024 using a panel data regression approach. Variables examined include digital infrastructure (mobile cellular subscriptions, internet usage, and fixed broadband subscriptions), macroeconomic conditions (GDP per capita and inflation measured via GDP deflator), the Economic Freedom Index, and electricity prices. Results from Fixed Effects and Random Effects models selected through Chow, Hausman, and Lagrange Multiplier tests indicate that mobile cellular subscriptions (MCS) represent the most significant positive driver of cryptocurrency adoption, consistent with Rogers' Diffusion of Innovation Theory. GDP per capita also shows a significant positive effect, supporting Markowitz's Portfolio Theory. The Economic Freedom Index exhibits a negative and significant relationship, suggesting that countries with weaker institutional frameworks experience greater cryptocurrency adoption as an alternative financial system. Inflation and electricity prices are not statistically significant across most models. Cryptocurrency adoption demonstrates a dual role: functioning as a portfolio diversification instrument in high-income countries and as an alternative financial system in economies with limited traditional financial access, where mobile infrastructure serves as the primary catalyst.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2021-2024年26个国家的面板数据，发现移动蜂窝订阅量是加密货币采纳的最重要正向驱动因素，GDP per capita也有显著正向影响，而经济自由指数呈显著负向关系，表明制度较弱的国家更倾向于采纳加密货币作为替代金融系统。
AI.research_question: 加密货币采纳的经济和金融决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 加密货币作为数字金融创新已引起全球关注，但对其采纳驱动因素的系统性实证研究尚不充分，尤其是在跨国面板数据层面。
AI.theoretical_framework: Rogers的扩散创新理论（解释移动基础设施的驱动作用）和Markowitz的投资组合理论（解释GDP per capita的正向效应）。
AI.method: 采用2021-2024年26个国家的面板数据，使用固定效应和随机效应模型，通过Chow检验、Hausman检验和拉格朗日乘子检验进行模型选择。
AI.findings: 移动蜂窝订阅量是最显著的正向驱动因素；GDP per capita有显著正向影响；经济自由指数呈显著负向关系；通胀和电价在多数模型中不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了扩散创新理论在加密货币领域的适用性，并揭示了加密货币采纳的双重角色：高收入国家的投资组合多样化工具与制度较弱国家的替代金融系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构理解加密货币在不同经济环境下的驱动因素提供了实证依据，提示发展中国家应重视移动基础设施建设以促进金融包容性。

title: Green Investment, Fiscal Sustainability, and NDC Compliance: A Fiscal Cost Decomposition for Korea Using the CO-STIRPAT Dynamic System

detail.title: Green Investment, Fiscal Sustainability, and NDC Compliance: A Fiscal Cost Decomposition for Korea Using the CO-STIRPAT Dynamic System
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether fiscally neutral green investment can simultaneously improve NDC compliance and remain budgetarily self-financing. Applying the CO-STIRPAT dynamic system—estimated on Korean data (1980–2024) and integrated with the OECD EDISON six-component fiscal accounting framework—to the Republic of Korea over 2025–2050, we find that a +10 trillion KRW annual investment shock generates a benefit-to-cost ratio of 1.37, confirming fiscal self-financing. However, the probability of NDC implementation rises only slightly, from approximately 10 to 11 percent by the 2030 review date, and remains well below 50 percent. This demonstrates that the 2030 NDC is a highly ambitious target, while also suggesting that the effectiveness of green investment could be largely offset by increased emissions arising from the economic activity that the fiscal multiplier sets in motion: faster GDP growth raises energy demand and emissions, counteracting the carbon-intensity gains from the green transition. The result implies that, to raise the probability of achieving the NDC while promoting accelerated GDP growth, green transition spending must be focused on carbon-neutral technology innovation that maximizes energy-efficiency improvements and carbon-intensity reductions—effects that must outweigh the increases in energy demand and emissions induced by green investment itself.

AI.tldr: 本文研究韩国财政中性的绿色投资能否同时改善NDC履约并实现预算自融资。发现10万亿韩元/年投资虽能产生1.37的收益成本比（自融资），但NDC实现概率仅从10%微升至11%，远低于50%。原因在于财政乘数引发的经济增长提高了能源需求与排放，抵消了绿色转型的碳强度收益。
AI.research_question: 财政中性的绿色投资能否同时改善国家自主贡献（NDC）合规性并保持预算自融资？
AI.motivation: 各国在NDC目标与财政可持续性之间面临权衡，需要验证绿色投资是否能在不增加财政负担的同时有效推动减排。
AI.theoretical_framework: CO-STIRPAT动态系统模型；OECD EDISON六组件财政核算框架；财政乘数理论；碳强度与能源需求的反弹效应。
AI.method: 基于韩国1980-2024年数据估计CO-STIRPAT动态模型，结合OECD EDISON财政核算框架，对2025-2050年进行情景模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）10万亿韩元/年绿色投资产生1.37的收益成本比，确认财政自融资；（2）NDC实现概率仅从约10%升至11%，远低于50%；（3）绿色投资的经济乘数效应引发GDP增长，提高能源需求与排放，抵消了碳强度改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了绿色投资的"反弹效应"机制：财政乘数驱动的经济增长会通过提高能源需求抵消绿色转型的碳强度收益，为理解绿色投资与NDC目标之间的张力提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者而言，仅靠规模性绿色投资不足以实现NDC目标；必须聚焦于碳中性技术创新，最大化能效改进与碳强度降低，使其效应超过投资本身引发的能源需求增长。

title: Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Drought and Land Use/Land Cover Change in Guli Locality, White Nile state Sudan
affiliations: University of Khartoum - Institute of Environmental Studies and Higher Council for Environment and Natural Resources

detail.title: Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Drought and Land Use/Land Cover Change in Guli Locality, White Nile state Sudan
detail.abstract: This study investigates drought severity, vegetation dynamics, and land use/land cover (LULC) changes in Guli locality, Sudan, using multi-temporal Landsat imagery (1985, 1995, 2015, and 2022). Remote sensing indices-Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI), and Normalized Difference Drought Index (NDDI)-were applied to assess vegetation health, water stress, and drought intensity. Supervised classification with Support Vector Machine (SVM) was used to generate LULC maps. Results show a marked shift in drought severity. Very low severity declined from 21% in 1985 to 1.7% in 2022, while moderate severity expanded from 18% to 47.6%, becoming the dominant category. High severity peaked at 59% in 2015 before declining to 30% in 2022, while very high severity dropped from 18% to 4.5%. NDVI analysis revealed localized vegetation recovery in northern and central areas, but persistent degradation in southern and eastern zones. LULC results highlight dramatic transformations: agriculture expanded from 8% to 26%, settlements grew from 6.4% to 38.8%, while rangelands declined from 61% to 22% and forests shrank by over 84%. These findings underscore the dual dynamics of drought intensification and land use change, with agricultural and urban expansion occurring alongside severe ecosystem degradation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用多时相Landsat影像（1985-2022年）分析苏丹Guli地区干旱严重程度、植被动态和土地利用/覆盖变化，发现中度干旱成为主导类别（从18%增至47.6%），农业和建设用地大幅扩张（分别增至26%和38.8%），而牧场（下降至22%）和森林（减少84%以上）严重退化，揭示了干旱加剧与土地利用变化的双重动态。
AI.research_question: 苏丹Guli地区过去近40年间（1985-2022年）干旱严重程度、植被动态和土地利用/覆盖变化呈现出怎样的时空演变特征？
AI.motivation: 干旱和土地退化是干旱和半干旱地区面临的重大环境挑战，而苏丹Guli地区缺乏系统的多时相遥感评估。本研究旨在通过遥感指数和分类方法，定量揭示该地区的生态环境变化，为土地管理和干旱缓解提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于遥感指数的干旱-植被-土地利用耦合分析框架，运用NDVI（植被健康）、NDWI（水分胁迫）和NDDI（干旱强度）三个指数协同评估，结合SVM监督分类进行土地利用分类。
AI.method: 采用多时相Landsat影像（1985、1995、2015、2022年），应用NDVI、NDWI、NDDI等遥感指数，并采用支持向量机（SVM）监督分类生成土地利用/覆盖地图。
AI.findings: （1）干旱严重程度显著变化：极低严重度从21%骤降至1.7%，中度严重度从18%扩大至47.6%（成为主导类别），高度严重度在2015年达到峰值59%后降至30%，极高严重度从18%降至4.5%。（2）植被恢复仅局限在北部和中部局部区域，南部和东部持续退化。（3）农业从8%增至26%，建设用地从6.4%猛增至38.8%，牧场从61%锐减至22%，森林减少超过84%。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多遥感指数（NDVI、NDWI、NDDI）在干旱半干旱地区综合评估干旱-植被-土地利用变化关系的有效性；揭示了干旱加剧与土地利用扩张（农业和城市）并存的双重动态机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏丹Guli地区提供了近40年土地覆盖和干旱变化的定量证据，警示农业和城市扩张导致的牧场和森林严重退化，可为当地土地规划、干旱防治和生态保护政策制定提供参考依据。

title: Social Origins and Access to Formal Employment: The Case of Peru
affiliations: Universidad Complutense Madrid, Instituto Complutense de Análisis Económico | ICAE and Department of Fundamentals of Economic Analysis I (Economic Analysis)

detail.title: Social Origins and Access to Formal Employment: The Case of Peru
detail.abstract: In highly informal economies, access to formal employment is not only a labor market outcome but also a powerful mechanism through which inequality of opportunity is reproduced across generations. We study this process in Peru by linking the 2017 Population Census to administrative payroll records for 2022 and, for the 1997 cohort, to school administrative records on parental education. We estimate cohort-specific probit models for individuals born between 1965 and 1997. Results show persistent circumstance-based stratification across generations. The urban-rural gap is the largest and most persistent source of inequality, accounting for gaps of 13 to 18 percentage points in formal employment across cohorts. Men retain an advantage in formal employment in every cohort, although the gender gap narrows among younger generations. Having Spanish as a mother tongue is associated with a 6-11 percentage-point premium, even after controlling for place of residence, while disability-especially cognitive and speech limitations-remains linked to substantially lower access, with little convergence over time. For the 1997 cohort, maternal education shows a stronger association with formal employment than paternal education. These findings suggest that in segmented labor markets, formal employment continues to reflect inherited disadvantage, and that expanding formalization alone will not level the playing field.

AI.tldr: 本文利用秘鲁2017年人口普查与2022年行政工资记录等数据，分析了1965至1997年出生队列在正规就业获取上的代际不平等。研究发现，城乡差距、性别差距、母语（西班牙语）优势和残障状况等先赋性因素持续导致正规就业机会分层，且教育代际传递在其中发挥关键作用。作者认为，仅靠扩大正规化无法消除这些结构性不平等。
AI.research_question: 在高度非正式经济体中，正规就业获取的代际不平等是如何被先赋性因素（如出生地、性别、母语、残障状况、父母教育）塑造的？
AI.motivation: 正规就业不仅是一种劳动力市场结果，更是代际不平等再生产的重要机制。在秘鲁等高度非正式经济体中，理解这一机制对于制定有效的平等化政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机会不平等理论（inequality of opportunity）；代际传递理论；劳动力市场分割理论。
AI.method: 将2017年秘鲁人口普查数据与2022年行政工资记录链接，并对1997年出生队列进一步链接学校行政记录中的父母教育信息。采用队列特定Probit模型，估计1965至1997年出生队列中先赋性因素对正规就业的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 城乡差距是最大且最持久的来源，造成正规就业13-18个百分点的差距；(2) 男性在所有队列中均有优势，但年轻队列中性别差距缩小；(3) 以西班牙语为母语者享有6-11个百分点的溢价；(4) 残障（尤其是认知和语言障碍）与显著较低的正规就业机会相关；(5) 对1997年队列，母亲教育比父亲教育与正规就业关联更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为机会不平等理论提供了来自高度非正式经济体的实证证据，揭示了正规就业作为代际不平等再生产渠道的机制，并区分了不同先赋性因素的相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者，仅依靠扩大正规化无法解决机会不平等问题，需要针对城乡差距、性别歧视、语言不平等和残障包容等结构性障碍采取针对性干预措施。

title: Conciliation as a Method of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR): Relationship and Distinction between Arbitration, Mediation and Negotiation
affiliations: Business School, The School of Science Management and Commerce

detail.title: Conciliation as a Method of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR): Relationship and Distinction between Arbitration, Mediation and Negotiation
detail.abstract: Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) has emerged as one of the most effective mechanisms for resolving disputes outside traditional courts. Among the various ADR methods, conciliation occupies a unique place because of its cooperative and relationship-oriented nature. The increasing burden on courts, high litigation expenses, and the need for speedy justice have encouraged legal systems worldwide to adopt ADR frameworks. This article critically examines conciliation as a dispute resolution mechanism and analyses its relationship with arbitration, mediation, and negotiation.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地考察了调解（conciliation）作为替代性争端解决机制（ADR）中的一种独特方式，分析了其与仲裁、调解（mediation）和谈判的关系，强调了其合作性与关系导向的本质。
AI.research_question: 调解作为争端解决机制的特点是什么？它与仲裁、调解（mediation）和谈判之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 法院案件负担日益加重、诉讼费用高昂以及对快速正义的需求，促使全球法律体系采纳ADR框架，而调解作为一种合作性、关系导向的机制值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代性争端解决（ADR）理论框架，重点关注调解（conciliation）与其他ADR机制（仲裁、调解mediation、谈判）的比较分析。
AI.method: 批判性分析（Critical analysis），基于文献和法律比较的方法。
AI.findings: 调解在ADR中占据独特地位，因其合作性和关系导向的特点，与仲裁、调解（mediation）和谈判既有联系又有区别。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了调解与其他ADR机制（仲裁、mediation、谈判）之间的概念区别与联系，丰富了ADR的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实践者选择争端解决机制提供了参考，强调了调解在处理需要维护长期关系的争端中的独特优势。

title: Collateral Policy Surprises
affiliations: German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin), German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin) and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Collateral Policy Surprises
detail.abstract: Central bank collateral policy specifies which assets banks can pledge as collateral to obtain central bank funding and is an important determinant of liquidity in the banking system. We propose a high-frequency identification approach to study the systematic effects of central bank collateral policy on banks, financial markets, and asset prices. We identify collateral policy surprises using intraday bank stock price changes around Eurosystem collateral policy announcements. Expansionary collateral policy surprises lead to excess returns of bank stocks, a decline in common volatility measures, and a reduction in bank default risk, in particular for riskier banks. They also compress core-periphery government bond spreads, even for policy changes that are unrelated to the collateral treatment of government bonds. The uneven transmission of collateral policy through banks to sovereign bond markets is distinct from both central bank asset purchases and conventional monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高频识别方法研究欧洲央行抵押品政策的系统性影响，发现扩张性抵押品政策意外能提升银行股超额收益、降低市场波动和银行违约风险，并压缩核心-外围国家主权债券利差，其传导机制不同于资产购买和传统货币政策。
AI.research_question: 中央银行抵押品政策对银行、金融市场和资产价格产生怎样的系统性影响？
AI.motivation: 抵押品政策决定了银行可用于获取央行融资的资产范围，是银行体系流动性的重要决定因素，但现有文献对其系统性影响的研究相对不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高频识别方法；抵押品政策冲击的识别与传导机制；银行风险承担渠道；主权债券市场传导渠道
AI.method: 利用欧洲央行抵押品政策公告期间的日内银行股价格变化来识别抵押品政策意外，采用事件研究法和高频数据分析。
AI.findings: (1)扩张性抵押品政策意外带来银行股超额回报；(2)降低常见波动率指标；(3)降低银行违约风险，对风险较高的银行影响更显著；(4)压缩核心-外围国家主权债券利差，即使与政府债券抵押品处理无关的政策变化也有此效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别了抵押品政策独立的传导机制，证明其与央行资产购买和传统货币政策的效果不同；揭示了抵押品政策通过银行向主权债券市场的不均匀传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行政策制定者提供了抵押品政策作为独立货币政策工具的效果评估；为市场监管者和投资者理解抵押品政策对市场稳定的影响提供了实证依据。

title: 교역에 대한 관세 탄력성 추정 방법론 연구: 한국 수입통관 자료에의 적용(A Study on Estimating Tariff Elasticities: Application to Korean Customs Data)
affiliations: Kyung Hee University - Department of International Trade and Business and Department of Economics, Kyung Hee University

detail.title: 교역에 대한 관세 탄력성 추정 방법론 연구: 한국 수입통관 자료에의 적용(A Study on Estimating Tariff Elasticities: Application to Korean Customs Data)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The importance of tariff measures in recent international trade has been highlighted again with the universal tariffs and reciprocal tariffs of the second Trump administration in the United States, as well as the retaliatory tariffs from trade partners. Interest in their economic effects is growing day by day. To properly analyze these economic effects, it is essential to accurately estimate the tariff elasticity of trade. This study comprehensively analyzes the main content of previous researches on the tariff elasticity of trade through a literature review, presenting various theoretical grounds and analytical methodologies. We applied these to Korea’s 2014 import clearance data to empirically estimate tariff elasticity. The main contents and analysis results of this study are as follows.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献综述和实证分析，利用韩国2014年进口清关数据，系统估计了贸易的关税弹性，为理解关税政策的经济效应提供了理论基础和方法论参考。
AI.research_question: 如何准确估计贸易的关税弹性？
AI.motivation: 近年来美国特朗普政府的普遍关税与对等关税以及贸易伙伴的报复性关税，使关税措施的重要性再次凸显，对其经济效应的关注日益增长。准确分析这些经济效应需要精确估计关税弹性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税弹性理论、国际贸易理论中关于关税对贸易流量影响的理论基础。
AI.method: 文献综述（梳理关税弹性的理论基础与分析方法）+ 实证分析（使用韩国2014年进口清关数据估计关税弹性）。
AI.findings: 系统梳理了关税弹性的理论依据与分析方法，并基于韩国数据进行实证估计（具体数值结果摘要中未提供）。
AI.theory_contributions: 综合整理了关税弹性研究的多重理论视角与分析方法，为后续研究提供了系统的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税变动对贸易流量的实际影响提供了实证依据和方法参考，尤其对当前中美贸易摩擦背景下的关税政策分析具有现实意义。

title: Integrating NDVI, NDWI, and NDDI for Drought Monitoring and Land Use Change Detection in Semi-Arid Sudan
affiliations: Higher Council for Environment and Natural Resources and University of Khartoum - Institute of Environmental Studies

detail.title: Integrating NDVI, NDWI, and NDDI for Drought Monitoring and Land Use Change Detection in Semi-Arid Sudan
detail.abstract: This study investigates drought severity, vegetation dynamics, and land use/land cover (LULC) changes in Tudulti locality, Sudan, using multi-temporal Landsat imagery (1985, 1995, 2015, and 2022). Remote sensing indices-Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI), and Normalized Difference Drought Index (NDDI)-were applied to evaluate vegetation health, water stress, and drought intensity. Supervised classification with Support Vector Machine (SVM) was used to generate LULC maps. Results reveal a strong shift toward moderate and high drought severity, with very low severity declining from 17.6% in 1985 to 0.2% in 2022, while high severity expanded from 26.6% to 60%. NDVI analysis showed a north-south gradient, with northern areas retaining healthier vegetation while southern and central zones experienced severe decline. LULC analysis highlighted dramatic agricultural expansion (1% to 23%), settlement growth (8% to 15%), and forest loss (12% to 3%). These findings demonstrate intensifying drought stress and rapid land use transformation, underscoring the need for integrated drought monitoring and sustainable land management strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用多时相Landsat影像（1985-2022年）分析苏丹Tudulti地区的干旱严重程度、植被动态和土地利用/覆盖变化，发现干旱加剧、农业扩张显著、森林大量减少。
AI.research_question: 苏丹Tudulti地区近40年来干旱严重程度、植被动态和土地利用/覆盖变化呈现怎样的时空演化特征？
AI.motivation: 苏丹等干旱地区面临严峻的水资源和土地退化问题，但长期多时相的遥感监测研究相对不足，需系统评估干旱与土地利用变化的耦合关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用NDVI（植被健康）、NDWI（水分胁迫）、NDDI（干旱强度）等遥感指数，结合土地利用分类理论（SVM监督分类），构建干旱-植被-土地利用变化分析框架。
AI.method: 采用1985、1995、2015、2022年多时相Landsat影像数据，应用NDVI、NDWI、NDDI遥感指数评估；使用支持向量机（SVM）监督分类生成土地利用/覆盖图。
AI.findings: (1) 干旱加剧：极高干旱面积从26.6%扩大到60%，极低干旱从17.6%降至0.2%；(2) 植被呈南北梯度，北部保留较好，南部和中部严重衰退；(3) 农业用地从1%扩至23%，建设用地从8%增至15%，森林从12%锐减至3%。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多遥感指数（NDVI-NDWI-NDDI）联合监测干旱-植被-土地利用变化的有效性，为干旱区生态环境评估提供了方法参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了Tudulti地区干旱加剧和土地快速转化的严峻现实，为苏丹及类似干旱地区制定综合干旱监测体系和可持续土地管理策略提供了科学依据。

title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Field Experiments to Explore Novel Features of Parental Speech and Foster Child Development
affiliations: University of Chicago, Independent, University of Chicago - Department of Economics, , University of Chicago, Independent and University of Chicago

detail.title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Field Experiments to Explore Novel Features of Parental Speech and Foster Child Development

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-80
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Parents play a critical role in shaping children's skills during the first years of life. Yet, identifying the contributors to richer learning environments remains difficult due to various unobservable factors. In this paper, we combine field experiments with AI to explore new acoustic features of parental speech. Specifically, we develop a signal processing model that uses more than 600 hours of recorded parent-child interactions combined with assessment data from two home-visiting experiments conducted in the Chicagoland area to identify features of parental speech that map into children's skills. Our two experiments consist of the same intervention helping parents provide nurturing interactions to their child. We exploit the experimental and natural variation in our data to explore two causal channels and one potential moderator. First, our intervention improves parental speech consistently across the two studies, as measured by acoustic features that are predictive of higher socioemotional skills and adult-child conversational turns. Further, we find that it also increases children's language skills in both experiments, as well as socioemotional skills in the second experiment. Interestingly, our heterogeneity analyses reveal that some of the interventions' impacts vary by socioeconomic groups, with patterns across the two experiments suggesting that the mechanisms are context-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合现场实验与AI技术，通过分析600小时以上的亲子互动录音，发现特定的父母言语声学特征能预测儿童技能发展，并验证了一项育儿干预对改善父母言语和提升儿童语言及社交情感技能的有效性，且效应在不同社会经济群体中存在异质性。
AI.research_question: 父母言语中的哪些声学特征能预测儿童技能发展？育儿干预如何通过影响这些声学特征来改善儿童的语言和社交情感技能？
AI.motivation: 父母在儿童早期发展中至关重要，但影响丰富学习环境的因素因存在多种不可观测变量而难以识别。本研究旨在利用AI和大规模录音数据，探索父母言语中新的声学特征及其对儿童技能的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童早期发展理论、亲子互动理论、言语声学特征与儿童技能发展的关联理论。
AI.method: 结合现场实验（芝加哥地区的两次家访实验）与AI信号处理模型，分析600小时以上的亲子互动录音，利用实验变异和自然变异探索两个因果渠道和一个潜在调节变量。
AI.findings: 1. 干预措施在两次实验中一致地改善了父母言语的声学特征，这些特征可预测更高的社交情感技能和成人-儿童对话轮次。2. 干预提升了两次实验中儿童的语言技能，以及第二次实验中的社交情感技能。3. 异质性分析显示，干预效果因社会经济群体而异，表明机制具有情境依赖性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将AI技术引入父母言语声学特征的分析，识别出与儿童技能发展相关的新特征，拓展了儿童早期发展领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为育儿干预提供了可量化的声学指标，有助于设计更精准的早期教育干预方案，并揭示了不同社会经济群体对干预的差异化反应，为政策制定提供参考。

title: Intergenerational Mobility in Late Qing Dynasty: Evidence from Northeast China
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility and New Economic School (NES)

detail.title: Intergenerational Mobility in Late Qing Dynasty: Evidence from Northeast China

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-79
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines intergenerational mobility across social classes during the late Qing dynasty employing a remarkable data set from Liaoning province in Northeast China. We identify two distinct epochs with markedly different mobility dynamics. Before 1850, mobility patterns exhibited stability and convergence toward a steady state. The second epoch, beginning around 1850, was characterized by unstable intergenerational class dynamics that persisted until the dynasty's collapse. The transition between epochs coincides with the Opium Wars and Taiping Rebellion, demonstrating how the footprints of major crises in the late Qing era can be traced in mobility dynamics. Employing Markov-chain measures and two alternative mobility conceptsthe persistence of class origin across generations and intergenerational class movement-we document that intergenerational mobility increased over the period. However, this aggregate increase masked a decline in upward mobility alongside a rise in downward mobility-disparate patterns that resonate with broader theories of political instability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用辽宁数据集，研究晚清时期社会阶层间的代际流动，发现1850年前后存在两个截然不同的时期：前期稳定收敛，后期动荡不安。鸦片战争和太平天国运动是重要转折点。总体代际流动性上升，但向上流动减少、向下流动增加，与政治不稳定理论相呼应。
AI.research_question: 晚清时期中国社会阶层间的代际流动性如何演变？重大历史危机如何影响代际流动动态？
AI.motivation: 理解重大历史危机（如鸦片战争、太平天国运动）对社会流动性的长期影响，以及代际流动性与政治不稳定之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际流动性理论、马尔可夫链模型、政治不稳定理论
AI.method: 利用中国辽宁省的独特历史数据集，采用马尔可夫链度量方法，分析两个维度的代际流动性：阶层起源的持久性和跨阶层流动。通过比较1850年前后两个时期的流动模式进行断点分析。
AI.findings: 1) 1850年前代际流动模式稳定并趋于稳态；2) 1850年后代际阶层动态不稳定并持续至清朝灭亡；3) 转折点与鸦片战争和太平天国运动重合；4) 总体代际流动性上升，但向上流动减少、向下流动增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了重大历史危机如何改变社会流动的长期轨迹，揭示了总体流动性增加与向上/向下流动方向性差异之间的张力，为政治不稳定理论提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史危机对社会结构的影响提供了实证基础，对当代社会政策制定中防范重大冲击对阶层流动的负面影响具有启示意义。

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-78
title: Pricing and Production Without The Invisible Hand
affiliations: Yale University,  and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Pricing and Production Without The Invisible Hand

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-78
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Modern theories of the business cycle do not allow for the simultaneous rational choice of both prices and quantities, instead assuming that an "invisible hand" determines one of these variables to clear markets. In this paper, we develop a macroeconomic framework in which both prices and quantities are chosen directly by firms, and exchange is both voluntary and efficient. Because of uncertainty about demand and productivity, individual product markets can be in excess supply or rationed. The absence of market-clearing changes pricing and production in qualitatively important ways: markups are no longer determined solely by the elasticity of demand, and higher uncertainty reduces production and increases markups. In equilibrium, production in rationed markets has a negative aggregate demand externality on demand in slack markets. Differently from New Keynesian economies, monetary shocks propagate by reducing economic slack, raising aggregate labor productivity and consumption, while uncertainty shocks act as stagflationary cost-push shocks. We integrate our theory of disequilibrium in a dynamic, rational-expectations "New Old Keynesian Model" and demonstrate its implications for the business cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个企业和家庭同时理性选择价格和数量的宏观经济框架，市场不一定出清，存在过剩供给或配给。该框架改变了定价与生产的逻辑：加成不再仅由需求弹性决定，不确定性会降低产量、提高加成。均衡中，配给市场的生产对 slack 市场的需求产生负的总体需求外部性。与新凯恩斯模型不同，货币冲击通过减少经济 slack 提高生产率与消费，不确定性冲击则像滞胀型成本推动冲击。作者将这种非均衡理论嵌入动态理性预期模型，展示了其商业周期含义。
AI.research_question: 在企业和家庭同时理性选择价格与数量的非市场出清条件下，宏观经济如何运行？商业周期有何不同特征？
AI.motivation: 现代商业周期理论不允许同时理性选择价格和数量，而是假设"看不见的手"决定其中一种变量以出清市场。本文试图放松这一假设，构建一个更符合实际的市场非出清框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非均衡宏观经济学（Non-Walrasian / Disequilibrium Theory）、理性预期、垄断竞争、价格与数量的同时选择、总体需求外部性。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个企业和家庭同时选择价格和数量的动态理性预期模型（"新旧凯恩斯模型"），在需求和生产存在不确定性的条件下分析非市场出清均衡。
AI.findings: （1）加成不再仅由需求弹性决定；（2）更高不确定性降低产量、提高加成；（3）配给市场的生产对 slack 市场的需求产生负的总体需求外部性；（4）货币冲击通过减少经济 slack 提高生产率与消费；（5）不确定性冲击像滞胀型成本推动冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在动态理性预期框架下系统整合价格与数量的同时理性选择，挑战了市场出清和新凯恩斯主义的定价教条，重新定义了加成定价和不确定性冲击的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解非市场出清条件下的商业周期（如衰退期需求不足、产能过剩）提供了新理论工具；对货币政策和不确定性冲击的宏观经济效应给出了不同于新凯恩斯模型的政策启示。

title: How Small is Small? Non-linearities in Heterogeneous Agent Models
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis and University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: How Small is Small? Non-linearities in Heterogeneous Agent Models

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-81
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In plausibly calibrated heterogeneous-agent models, marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) are highly non-linear in wealth, falling sharply away from borrowing constraints. As a result, the aggregate consumption response to a fiscal transfer is strongly concave in its size: larger transfers shift households out of high-MPC regions and thereby dampen the consumption response. Across partial-and general-equilibrium settings, linear methods substantially overstate the effects of fiscal stimulus at empirically relevant sizes. Local methods are not reliable for studying shocks and policies where a failure of Ricardian equivalence is important.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在合理校准的异质性主体模型中，边际消费倾向（MPCs）随财富增加呈高度非线性下降，导致财政转移支付的消费反应强烈凹形——转移规模越大，消费刺激效果越弱。线性方法会显著高估实际效果，局部方法在李嘉图等价失效情形下不可靠。
AI.research_question: 财政转移支付规模如何影响异质性主体模型中的总消费反应？线性与局部方法在评估此类政策时是否可靠？
AI.motivation: 传统线性或局部方法在评估财政刺激政策时可能严重偏离实际，因为异质性代理人的MPC随财富高度非线性变化，需要系统检验不同方法的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性代理人模型（Heterogeneous-Agent Models）、边际消费倾向（MPC）的非线性、李嘉图等价（Ricardian Equivalence）失效理论。
AI.method: 基于合理校准的异质性主体模型，分别在局部均衡和一般均衡框架下，模拟不同规模财政转移支付的效果，并比较线性方法与非线性方法的差异。
AI.findings: （1）MPC随财富增加高度非线性下降；（2）总消费反应与转移规模呈凹形关系；（3）线性方法显著高估实际消费刺激效果；（4）局部方法在李嘉图等价失效情形下不可靠。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了财政转移支付规模与消费反应之间的非线性凹形关系，指出了线性方法和局部方法在评估财政刺激政策时的根本性局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和央行设计财政刺激政策提供重要参考：大规模转移支付的效果会被边际消费倾向下降所抵消；政策评估应使用全局非线性方法而非传统线性或局部方法。

title: The EU as a Borrower: Reconnecting the Debate on an EMU Fiscal Space and the EU Budget
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Law

detail.title: The EU as a Borrower: Reconnecting the Debate on an EMU Fiscal Space and the EU Budget

declarations.funderStatement: European Court of Auditors

detail.abstract: The article reconnects debates on Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) and the EU budget, challenging their traditional separation. By revisiting early discussions on EMU, it highlights the often-overlooked “budgetary dimension” of European integration. Examining financial instruments from the 1970s to NextGenerationEU (NGEU), the article shows how the EU has repeatedly activated a “dormant” borrowing capacity during crises by building on existing financial models. It argues that the EU budget has acted as a silent guarantor for joint debt issuance and financial stability, making it a crucial yet underappreciated pillar of European economic integration and fiscal governance.

AI.tldr: 本文重新连接了经济货币联盟（EMU）与欧盟预算的讨论，挑战了二者传统的分离视角。通过回顾EMU早期讨论，揭示了欧洲一体化中常被忽视的“预算维度”。文章考察了从1970年代到下一代欧盟（NGEU）的金融工具，展示了欧盟如何在危机中通过基于现有金融模式反复激活“休眠”的借贷能力。文章认为，欧盟预算充当了联合债务发行与金融稳定的沉默担保人，使其成为欧洲经济一体化与财政治理中至关重要但未被充分认识的支柱。
AI.research_question: 经济货币联盟（EMU）与欧盟预算之间存在怎样的内在联系？欧盟预算在联合债务发行和金融稳定中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统研究将EMU与欧盟预算视为两个独立议题，本文旨在挑战这一分离视角，重新连接二者，揭示欧盟预算在欧洲经济一体化中被低估的关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲一体化理论、财政联邦主义、危机驱动的制度变迁理论
AI.method: 历史制度分析法，梳理从1970年代至NGEU的金融工具演变
AI.findings: 欧盟在危机中反复通过激活“休眠”借贷能力来应对挑战；欧盟预算充当了联合债务发行的沉默担保人，是欧洲经济一体化与财政治理的关键支柱。
AI.theory_contributions: 弥合了EMU研究与欧盟预算研究之间的理论鸿沟，提出了“预算维度”作为欧洲一体化分析的新视角；揭示了欧盟预算作为“沉默担保人”的制度角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解欧盟在危机中创新金融工具（如NGEU）提供了历史制度基础；对欧盟未来财政改革和治理设计具有政策启示。

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study analyzes how patterns of change in global value chains (GVCs) have evolved among seven major Asian countries as the structural transformation of GVCs has deepened after the U.S.–China trade war. In particular, we closely examine whether India, Vietnam, and other key ASEAN countries are likely to play roles as indirect export and production hubs in response to GVC change. To this end, we use the ADB Multiregional Input–Output (MRIO) data for the 2015–2023 period and conduct an analysis that includes the latest information. To identify the flow of GVC change before and after the U.S.–China trade war, we divide the analysis period into three stages: the pre-trade-war period, Trump’s first term, and the Biden administration period. Through this analysis, the study aims to present policy proposals that enable Korea to respond effectively to the rapidly changing GVC environment by cooperating with India and major ASEAN countries such as Vietnam and Indonesia, thereby coping effectively with the evolving global economic order.

AI.tldr: 本文分析中美贸易战后全球价值链（GVC）在七个主要亚洲国家中的变化模式，特别关注印度、越南及东盟国家是否可能成为间接出口和生产枢纽，并利用2015-2023年ADB多区域投入产出数据进行阶段分析，为韩国提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 中美贸易战后全球价值链在亚洲主要国家间的变化模式如何演变？印度、越南及东盟国家是否可能成为间接出口和生产枢纽？
AI.motivation: 随着中美贸易战后全球价值链结构性转型深化，亚洲各国在全球价值链中的角色正在发生变化。韩国需要准确理解这些变化，以便与印度和东盟主要国家合作，有效应对快速变化的GVC环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链（GVC）结构性转型理论、间接出口与生产枢纽理论
AI.method: 使用ADB多区域投入产出（MRIO）数据，时间跨度为2015-2023年；将分析期分为三个阶段：贸易战前、特朗普第一任期、拜登政府时期。
AI.findings: （待分析结果——摘要中未直接给出具体发现，但预期揭示印度、越南及东盟国家在GVC中作为间接出口和生产枢纽的角色变化。）
AI.theory_contributions: 将GVC变化模式分析扩展到中美贸易战后的最新阶段（含拜登时期），细化亚洲国家间GVC角色演变的动态分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国提供与印度、越南、印度尼西亚等东盟主要国家合作的政策建议，帮助其有效应对快速变化的全球价值链环境和经济秩序重构。

title: Operational Flexibility in Gas-Fired Power Plants Under Climate Policy Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Piemonte Orientale (UPO) and Bocconi University - Department of Finance

detail.title: Operational Flexibility in Gas-Fired Power Plants Under Climate Policy Uncertainty
detail.abstract: We study the valuation of a flexible gas-fired turbine for electricity production under uncertainty in clean spark spread components and under varying degrees of environmental policy stringency. Within a real options framework, we develop a fast and computationally efficient lattice-based valuation methodology that incorporates jump dynamics in electricity and natural gas prices together with regime-switching behaviour in carbon allowance markets, consistently with the empirical evidence of fat tails, skewness, and structural breaks in energy market data. Numerical results show that tighter environmental policies reduce expected cash flows while increasing the value of operational flexibility, particularly under persistent high carbon-cost regimes. When climate policy uncertainty is explicitly modelled, faster resolution further enhances flexibility value by enabling earlier adaptation to changing market conditions, while also affecting downside risk exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文在碳市场存在体制转换的背景下，研究灵活燃气轮机发电厂的实物期权估值方法，并分析环境政策严格度对运营灵活性和现金流的影响。
AI.research_question: 在清洁火花价差存在不确定性且环境政策严格度不同的条件下，如何对灵活燃气轮机进行估值？
AI.motivation: 能源市场数据存在厚尾、偏斜和结构性断裂特征，而碳配额市场呈现体制转换行为，传统估值方法未能同时捕捉这些特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论、格点估值方法、跳扩散过程、体制转换模型
AI.method: 基于格点的高效数值估值方法，同时纳入电力与天然气价格的跳动态以及碳配额市场的体制转换行为。
AI.findings: （1）更严格的环境政策降低预期现金流但增加运营灵活性价值，尤其是在持续高碳成本体制下；（2）气候政策不确定性明确建模时，更快的不确定性解决通过使企业更早适应市场变化而进一步提升灵活性价值，同时也影响下行风险敞口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将跳扩散与体制转换同时纳入实物期权格点估值框架，为能源资产估值提供了更具现实特征的数值方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发电厂投资者和政策制定者量化评估环境政策严格度及政策不确定性对灵活发电资产价值的影响提供了分析工具。

title: 통상조약법의 발전방향에 관한 연구(A Study on the Future Development of Trade Agreement Law)
