publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Act on the Conclusion Procedure and Implementation of Commercial Treaties (hereinafter, the “Commerce Treaty Act”) was enacted in 2012 to address the lack of procedural transparency and insufficient public participation revealed during major trade negotiations, notably the Korea–U.S. Free Trade Agreement (FTA). The Act aimed to institutionalize transparency, predictability, and stakeholder participation across all stages—from negotiation to post-entry implementation—while ensuring systematic and democratic oversight of Korea’s trade policy.

Despite its initial promise, several institutional limitations have emerged. Certain procedures risked becoming mere formalities, undermining the Act’s purpose, while rapid shifts in the trade environment, including digital trade, supply chain realignment, and climate-related regulation, exposed gaps in its scope and adaptability. In particular, new forms of economic agreements that diverge from traditional tariff-based liberalization often fall outside the statutory definition of a “trade agreement,” weakening both democratic control and policy responsiveness.

This study therefore seeks to identify reform directions that can strengthen the Commerce Treaty Act’s legal coherence, democratic legitimacy, and practical effectiveness. The research focuses on four main objectives: enhancing institutional coherence, improving democratic transparency and oversight, ensuring effective domestic implementation, and reinforcing the legal framework to address structural changes in global trade governance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了韩国《商业条约程序与实施法》（2012年颁布）在增强贸易谈判透明度与公众参与方面的成效与局限，指出该法在制度设计上存在形式化风险，且难以适应数字贸易、供应链重组、气候规制等新型贸易议题，尤其是新型经济协定常被排除在“贸易协定”定义之外，削弱了民主控制与政策响应能力。研究提出四方面改革方向：增强制度一致性、提升民主透明度与监督、确保国内有效实施、强化法律框架以应对全球贸易治理的结构性变化。
AI.research_question: 如何改革韩国《商业条约程序与实施法》，以增强其法律一致性、民主合法性与实践有效性，从而适应全球贸易治理的结构性变化？
AI.motivation: 该法自2012年颁布以来，在提升贸易谈判透明度与公众参与方面取得初步成效，但面临程序形式化、无法覆盖新型经济协定（如数字贸易、供应链重组、气候规制）等制度性局限，亟需识别改革方向以强化其民主控制与政策响应能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该法以程序透明度、可预测性、利益相关方参与为制度核心，依托“系统性民主监督”理念构建从谈判到实施的全过程治理框架；研究批判性地审视了传统“贸易协定”定义在新型经济治理中的适用性缺陷。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析与制度评估，通过对该法实施以来的制度运行进行批判性审视，识别程序形式化风险与治理空白，提出四维度的改革路径。
AI.findings: 该法存在以下缺陷：（1）部分程序沦为形式化流程，偏离立法初衷；（2）贸易环境剧变（数字贸易、供应链重组、气候规制）暴露了法律覆盖面与适应性的不足；（3）新型经济协定（非传统关税减让型）常被排除在“贸易协定”法定定义之外，削弱了民主控制与政策响应能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判性地揭示了传统“贸易协定”法定定义在新型全球经济治理中的适用性困境，为贸易法学的概念扩展提供了理论依据；系统论证了程序透明度制度在面对治理议题剧变时的形式化风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国立法机构提供了四大改革方向的具体框架：增强制度一致性、提升民主透明度与监督、确保国内有效实施、强化法律框架以应对全球贸易治理的结构性变化，具有直接的政策参考价值。

title:
The Black-scholes Formula as a Hidden Optimization Problem: 
A Reverse-engineering Exercise Connecting the Envelope Theorem to Option Pricing

detail.title:
The Black-scholes Formula as a Hidden Optimization Problem: 
A Reverse-engineering Exercise Connecting the Envelope Theorem to Option Pricing
detail.abstract: Students trained in microeconomic theory are accustomed to the Envelope Theorem: when differentiating a value function with respect to a parameter, the indirect effects operating through optimal choices vanish by the first-order conditions. Upon encountering the Black-Scholes-Merton (BSM) formula, these students face a puzzle. Computing the option's sensitivity to time (Theta) requires the chain rule through the auxiliary variables d1 and d2, yet the final expression simplifies dramatically as if some hidden optimization were at work. This note proposes a pedagogical reverse engineering exercise: I construct an artificial constrained optimization problem in which d1 and d2 are elevated from mere statistical definitions to genuine choice variables. The first-order conditions of the associated Lagrangian recover the well-known BSM identity S N ′ (d1) = Ke-r(T-t) N ′ (d2), and the Envelope Theorem then delivers Theta in a single step, bypassing all chain-rule algebra. The exercise bridges a gap between the microeconomic and quantitative-finance curricula, offering students an economic interpretation of a formula that is typically presented as purely statistical.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构造一个假想的约束优化问题，将Black-Scholes-Merton公式中的d1和d2从统计定义提升为真正的选择变量，利用包络定理一步推导出期权Theta，从而为微观经济学与金融工程课程之间架起一座桥梁。
AI.research_question: 如何利用微观经济学中的包络定理（Envelope Theorem）来简化Black-Scholes-Merton公式中Theta（期权对时间的敏感性）的推导，并为学生提供更直观的经济学解释？
AI.motivation: 学习微观经济理论的学生熟悉包络定理，但遇到Black-Scholes-Merton公式时感到困惑——计算Theta需要通过对d1和d2应用链式法则，但最终表达式却大幅简化，仿佛存在某种隐藏的最优化过程。作者希望揭示这一"隐藏的最优化"结构，填补微观经济学与定量金融课程之间的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包络定理（Envelope Theorem）；拉格朗日最优化方法；Black-Scholes-Merton期权定价模型。
AI.method: 本文采用逆向工程（reverse engineering）的教学方法：人为构造一个约束优化问题，将d1和d2从单纯的统计定义重新定义为真正的选择变量。通过构建拉格朗日函数并求解一阶条件，恢复著名的BSM恒等式 S N'(d1) = Ke^{-r(T-t)} N'(d2)，然后利用包络定理一步推导出Theta，完全绕过链式法则的代数运算。
AI.findings: 通过构造人工优化问题，包络定理可以直接导出BSM期权Theta的简洁表达式，无需繁琐的链式法则计算。该方法揭示了BSM公式背后隐藏的最优化结构，使Theta公式获得了经济学解释：它对应于约束条件（期权定价方程）对时间的偏导数在最优点处的取值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为包络定理在金融衍生品定价中的应用提供了新的教学视角；揭示了Black-Scholes-Merton公式中原本被视为纯统计定义的d1和d2变量实际上可以赋予经济学的选择变量含义；将微观经济学与定量金融学两大课程体系在方法论上进行了连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融专业学生和量化从业者提供了一种更直观、更经济的理解BSM Greeks（尤其是Theta）的方法；作为一种教学工具，可以帮助学生从微观经济学的视角理解原本"纯统计"的期权定价公式，降低学习门槛；有助于金融课程与经济学课程的跨学科融合教学。

title: The Effect of Height on Adolescents' Body Image Perceptions and Behaviors
affiliations: Syracuse University, Syracuse University and Syracuse University

detail.title: The Effect of Height on Adolescents' Body Image Perceptions and Behaviors

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper estimates the causal effect of height on adolescents’ body image, encompassing self-perceptions of weight, the accuracy of those perceptions, and weight-management aspirations. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (NLSY97), we leverage within-individual variation in height during adolescence and condition on body mass index (BMI) to isolate the effects of height on body image outcomes. We find that taller adolescents are more likely to perceive themselves as overweight, even holding BMI constant, and are less likely to underestimate their weight category. However, the direction of misclassification diverges by gender: taller boys are more likely to correctly assess their weight category, while taller girls are more likely to overestimate it. These perception shifts translate into behavioral responses for girls but not for boys. A one-inch increase in height raises the probability that a girl reports wanting to lose weight by 3.0 percentage points (6.2 percent), with effects concentrated among girls in the normal weight range. Taken together, these findings establish height as a salient determinant of body image in adolescence, operating independently of body mass.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现，在控制BMI的情况下，身高较高的青少年更倾向于认为自己超重，且更少低估自己的体重类别。身高对体重感知的影响存在性别差异：高个子男孩更可能正确评估体重类别，而高个子女孩更可能高估体重。身高每增加1英寸，女孩报告想要减肥的概率上升3.0个百分点（6.2%），但对男孩无显著行为影响。
AI.research_question: 身高对青少年身体意象（包括体重自我认知、认知准确性及体重管理意愿）的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有研究主要关注体重（BMI）对身体意象的影响，但身高作为独立于体重的身体特征，其对身体意象的作用尚不明晰。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示身高在青少年身体意象形成中的独立作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身体意象理论、社会比较理论、性别角色社会化理论
AI.method: 使用美国国家青少年纵向调查（NLSY97）数据，利用青少年时期个体内部身高变化，在控制BMI的条件下，采用个体固定效应模型估计身高的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）控制BMI后，身高越高的青少年越倾向于认为自己超重，且更少低估体重类别；（2）存在性别差异：高个子男孩更可能正确评估体重，高个子女孩更可能高估体重；（3）身高每增加1英寸，女孩报告想要减肥的概率上升3.0个百分点（6.2%），该效应集中在正常体重女孩中；（4）身高对男孩的体重管理行为无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将身高确立为独立于BMI的青少年身体意象决定因素，拓展了身体意象形成机制的理论认识；揭示身高效应的性别差异，丰富了身体意象的性别差异理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为青少年心理健康干预提供新视角：在关注肥胖问题的同时，需警惕身高因素带来的身体意象扭曲，特别是正常体重高个子女孩的不必要减肥行为。

title: Asymmetric Information, Bank Screening, and Green Credit Allocation

detail.title: Asymmetric Information, Bank Screening, and Green Credit Allocation
detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of firm-type heterogeneity and dual information asymmetry, this study develops a finite-horizon continuous-time dynamic game model between banks and firms, incorporating signal screening, audit verification, and differentiated contracts into a unified analytical framework. The model embeds both adverse selection and moral hazard within a coupled state–costate system, thereby characterizing the dynamic interactions between banks and firms under asymmetric information and examining how dynamic interest rates, audit probabilities, and signaling costs affect firm behavior and resource allocation. Using the Hamiltonian approach and Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle, the study derives the corresponding optimality conditions and conducts numerical simulations to compare dynamic trajectories under three alternative mechanisms: no-screening, signaling-only, and signaling combined with auditing. The results show that reliance on signaling alone is insufficient to sustain effective screening over time, whereas the introduction of auditing helps reduce the discrepancy between firms’ reported and actual investment, improves the precision of green credit allocation, and enhances green capital accumulation. The study provides a theoretical reference for the design and policy optimization of green credit mechanisms, and further indicates that the coordinated use of screening, verification, and differentiated contracts can effectively mitigate adverse selection and moral hazard under asymmetric information.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含信号筛选、审计验证和差异化合同的有限时域连续时间动态博弈模型，研究银行与企业在信息不对称下的动态交互。结果显示，仅依赖信号筛选不足以维持有效筛选，引入审计能缩小企业报告与实际投资的差距，提高绿色信贷配置精度和绿色资本积累。
AI.research_question: 在异质性企业和双重信息不对称背景下，银行如何通过动态利率、审计概率和信号成本的协调机制，有效缓解逆向选择和道德风险，优化绿色信贷资源配置？
AI.motivation: 现实中绿色信贷面临企业类型异质性和双重信息不对称（事前逆向选择与事后道德风险），现有研究缺乏将信号筛选、审计验证与差异化合同纳入统一动态框架的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限时域连续时间动态博弈模型、哈密顿方法、庞特里亚金最大值原理、状态-协状态耦合系统、逆向选择与道德风险双重嵌入。
AI.method: 构建连续时间动态博弈模型，采用哈密顿方法与庞特里亚金最大值原理推导最优条件，并通过数值模拟比较无筛选、仅信号筛选、信号筛选+审计三种机制的动态轨迹。
AI.findings: （1）仅依赖信号筛选不足以长期维持有效筛选；（2）引入审计能缩小企业报告投资与实际投资的差距；（3）审计提高了绿色信贷的配置精度；（4）审计促进了绿色资本积累。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号筛选、审计验证与差异化合同纳入统一动态分析框架，构建了嵌入双重信息不对称的状态-协状态耦合系统，拓展了绿色信贷机制设计的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为绿色信贷机制设计和政策优化提供理论参考，表明协调使用筛选、验证与差异化合同可有效缓解信息不对称带来的逆向选择和道德风险问题。

title: GLP-1 Therapy and the Reshaping of Socioeconomic Gradients in Health
affiliations: University of Southern California, University of Southern California - Schaeffer Center for Health Policy  and Economics, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) and University of Southern California - Schaeffer Center for Health Policy  and Economics

detail.title: GLP-1 Therapy and the Reshaping of Socioeconomic Gradients in Health

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
GLP-1 therapies for obesity promise substantial health improvements, but little is known about how their benefits vary across socioeconomic and demographic groups. Using a nationally representative microsimulation model of US adults and Shapely-value decomposition, we estimate the lifetime health and economic benefits of GLP-1 treatment and examine how those gains vary across individuals. The largest differences emerge across education. Individuals with less than a high school education experience experience roughly 14% higher gains in lifetime net social value, 16-17% larger improvements in discounted generalized risk- and severity-adjusted life-years (GRASA-QALYs), and 20% greater increases in life expectancy relative to the cohort mean, whereas individuals with college degrees experience gains 15-27% below the mean across these outcomes. Black and Hispanic individuals also tend to experience larger improvements in health outcomes and social value than White individuals, including larger gains in GRASA-QALYs and life expectancy and larger reductions in diabetes risk and duration. Females likewise experience larger predicted treatment gains than men. These patterns are consistent with the idea that the largest gains arise among populations facing greater socioeconomic constraints in sustaining behavioral weight control. GLP-1 innovation may therefore mitigate inequality in obesity-related disease and survival, advancing equity in population health.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国全国代表性微观模拟模型和Shapley值分解，估计GLP-1疗法对不同社会经济和人口群体的终生健康与经济收益，发现低教育程度、黑人和西班牙裔以及女性群体获得的健康改善和净社会价值增益更大，表明GLP-1创新可能减轻肥胖相关疾病和生存的不平等，促进人口健康公平。
AI.research_question: GLP-1肥胖疗法的健康和经济收益如何在不同社会经济和人口群体之间变化？
AI.motivation: GLP-1疗法有望带来显著健康改善，但不同社会经济和人口群体的获益差异尚不清楚，了解这些差异对评估其对健康不平等的影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 肥胖的疾病负担理论、健康不平等的社会经济梯度理论、行为体重控制的社会经济约束假说。
AI.method: 使用美国全国代表性微观模拟模型，结合Shapley值分解方法，估计GLP-1治疗的终生健康和经济收益，并按教育、种族/民族、性别分组比较。
AI.findings: （1）最大差异出现在教育层面：低于高中教育水平的个体在终生净社会价值、GRASA-QALYs和预期寿命改善上分别比队列均值高出约14%、16-17%和20%，而大学学历者比均值低15-27%。（2）黑人和西班牙裔比白人获得更大改善。（3）女性比男性获得更大治疗收益。（4）这些模式支持"面临更大社会经济约束的群体获益最大"的假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 将健康不平等理论与肥胖治疗干预相结合，揭示GLP-1疗法可能减轻而非加剧健康不平等，为理解医药创新对健康公平的影响提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和医疗从业者提供GLP-1疗法分配和定价的公平性考量依据，提示应优先关注低教育程度、少数族裔和女性群体以最大限度地促进健康公平。

title: Does Regional Variation in Wage Levels Identify the Effects of a National Minimum Wage?
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)

detail.title: Does Regional Variation in Wage Levels Identify the Effects of a National Minimum Wage?

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper asks whether regional wage differences can identify the effects of a national minimum wage. I study two common exposure-based approaches: effective-minimum-wage designs, which compare the minimum wage to contemporaneous local wages, and fraction-affected/gap designs, which measure pre-reform exposure to the new minimum. Using theory, simulations, and evidence from Brazil, I show when these approaches can mislead and how their performance depends on specification choices. The results lead to practical recommendations for applied researchers, including when to avoid these designs, how to test their assumptions, which specifications are more reliable, and how similar concerns may apply to other settings.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于区域工资差异识别全国最低工资效应的两种常见方法（有效最低工资设计和受冲击比例/缺口设计）的可靠性，通过理论分析、模拟和巴西数据验证，揭示了这些方法在何种情况下可能产生误导，并为应用研究者提供了实践建议。
AI.research_question: 区域工资差异能否用于识别全国最低工资的因果效应？两种常见的暴露度方法（有效最低工资设计和受冲击比例/缺口设计）在什么条件下是可靠的？
AI.motivation: 全国最低工资政策没有区域层面的变化，传统双重差分等方法难以识别其效应。研究者常用基于区域工资差异的暴露度设计来克服这一识别难题，但这些方法的有效性前提和潜在偏误尚未被系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 暴露度方法识别假设（包括有效最低工资设计和受冲击比例/缺口设计）；区域工资差异与最低工资政策效应的关系理论；平行趋势假设在暴露度设计中的适用条件。
AI.method: 综合运用理论推导、数值模拟和巴西微观数据实证分析，系统评估两种暴露度方法在不同设定下的表现，比较不同规范选择（如衡量标准、控制变量、样本范围）对结果的影响。
AI.findings: 两种暴露度方法在特定条件下均可能产生误导性结论；方法的可靠性高度依赖于规范选择（如暴露度的度量方式、回归设定等）；提供了何时应避免使用这些方法、如何检验关键假设、哪些规范更可靠的实践指南。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统厘清了暴露度方法在识别全国最低工资效应时的识别条件与潜在偏误来源，填补了该领域方法论检验的理论空白；揭示了区域工资差异作为识别策略的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应用研究者提供了具体的操作建议：何时避免使用暴露度设计、如何检验假设、选择更可靠的规范设定；提醒类似偏误问题可能存在于其他政策评估场景中。

title: Macroeconomic and Fiscal Consequences of Quantitative Easing
affiliations: International Monetary Fund, International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund MCMMP

detail.title: Macroeconomic and Fiscal Consequences of Quantitative Easing

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Quantitative easing (QE) has been criticized for helping fuel the post-COVID inflation boom and causing large central bank losses. In this paper, we argue that QE should be evaluated mainly on its ability to achieve core macro-objectives as well for its effects on the consolidated fiscal position of the government and central bank, although central bank losses can matter to the extent that they may weaken central bank credibility. Using a DSGE model with segmented asset markets, we show how QE can provide a sizeable boost to output and inflation in a deep liquidity trap and can reduce public debt substantially. This contrasts to the rise in public debt that occurs under fiscal expansion and makes QE an attractive tool in a high debt environment. There is more reason for caution in using QE in a "shallow" liquidity trap in which the notional interest rate is only slightly negative: QE runs more risk of causing the economy to overheat, especially if forward guidance has a strong element of commitment, and is more likely to generate sizeable central bank losses. Some refinements in strategy, including the use of escape clauses, can help mitigate overheating risks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DSGE模型论证量化宽松（QE）在深度流动性陷阱中能有效刺激产出和通胀并降低公共债务，但在浅流动性陷阱中可能导致经济过热和央行损失，建议通过策略改进（如退出条款）来降低风险。
AI.research_question: 量化宽松政策在何种条件下能有效实现核心宏观经济目标？其对政府与央行合并财政状况有何影响？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代QE因助长通胀和导致央行巨额亏损而备受批评，但现有研究对QE在不同经济环境下的效果差异性分析不足，尤其缺乏对深度与浅流动性陷阱的对比分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分割资产市场的动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，区分深度流动性陷阱与浅流动性陷阱两种情形，考虑前瞻指引的承诺强度及退出条款的调节作用。
AI.method: 构建包含分割资产市场的DSGE模型进行数值模拟，对比QE与财政扩张在产出、通胀、公共债务及央行损失等方面的差异效果。
AI.findings: （1）在深度流动性陷阱中，QE能大幅提振产出与通胀，显著降低公共债务，优于财政扩张；（2）在浅流动性陷阱中，QE易导致经济过热，尤其在强承诺前瞻指引下风险更大，且可能产生较大央行损失；（3）引入退出条款等策略调整可缓解过热风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了QE在深度与浅流动性陷阱中的异质性效果，揭示了QE与财政扩张对公共债务的不同影响机制，为优化QE操作策略提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行在债务高企环境下使用QE提供了政策建议：深度陷阱中QE是优选工具，浅陷阱中需谨慎并配合退出条款等风险管理措施。

title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Oslo - Department of Economics, University of Chicago and Princeton University

detail.title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates—and, to a lesser extent, award rates—within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2013年以来美国SSDI（社会保障残疾保险）项目 enrollment 下降的原因，发现主要归因于特定人口群体（尤其是中低技能男性）的申请率和通过率下降，而改善的劳动力市场机会是关键解释因素。
AI.research_question: 什么因素导致了2013年以来美国SSDI项目 enrollment 的持续下降？
AI.motivation: SSDI enrollment 在经历了1990-2000年代的大幅增长后，自2013年起持续下降，需要系统性量化各因素的贡献，并识别背后的因果机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计分解方法；劳动力市场机会与残疾保险申请行为的经济学理论。
AI.method: 使用详细的行政数据进行统计分解，并结合因果分析（改善的劳动力市场机会对中低技能男性SSDI申请的因果效应）。
AI.findings: （1）2013年以来的 enrollment 下降绝大部分归因于各人口群内部的申请率下降（以及较小程度上的通过率下降），人口结构变化、资格变化或退出SSDI的贡献很小；（2）下降主要由中低技能男性驱动，他们随时间推移更可能工作、更少申请SSDI；（3）因果分析表明，改善的劳动力市场机会是核心解释因素；（4）其他流行假说（如上诉层面通过率降低）缺乏证据支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了SSDI enrollment 下降中各因素的相对贡献，排除了人口结构变化等替代解释，并提供了劳动力市场条件影响残疾保险申请的因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解SSDI enrollment 动态提供了实证基础，表明改善劳动力市场条件可以有效降低残疾保险依赖，同时反驳了通过调整上诉通过率等政策手段的有效性。

title: Do Voters Punish Inflation or Pay Cuts? Inflation and Real Wages in U.S. Elections
affiliations: Georgetown University and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: Do Voters Punish Inflation or Pay Cuts? Inflation and Real Wages in U.S. Elections

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Between 2021 and 2024, the United States experienced one of the most severe inflation episodes in decades, coinciding with renewed debate over the role of economic conditions for electoral outcomes. This paper studies the political economy of inflation and real wages using U.S. county-level data on family budget costs, nominal income, and electoral results for President and Congress during this period. Exploiting within-state, cross-county variation in changes in local prices over time, it examines how inflation, real wage growth, and purchasing power relate to changes in vote shares of incumbents, vote margins, and turnout. Real wage decline, rather than higher inflation, is predictive of Republican electoral gains, in line with an economic voting rationale. Inflation, however, retains an association with presidential vote shares beyond pure economic voting.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2021-2024年美国县级数据，研究通胀、实际工资增长与购买力对选举结果（总统和国会）的影响，发现实际工资下降（而非高通胀本身）更能预测共和党得票增长，但通胀对总统投票份额仍有超出纯经济投票的额外影响。
AI.research_question: 2021-2024年美国通胀期间，通胀、实际工资增长和购买力如何影响总统和国会的选举结果（得票率、投票率、竞争程度）？
AI.motivation: 近年来美国经历了数十年来最严重的通胀，关于经济状况对选举结果作用的争论再次兴起，需要系统考察通胀、实际工资与选举之间的复杂关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济投票理论（economic voting rationale）
AI.method: 利用美国县级面板数据，包含家庭预算成本、名义收入、总统和国会选举结果；采用州内县际价格变化差异（within-state, cross-county variation）的识别策略。
AI.findings: （1）实际工资下降（而非高通胀本身）更能预测共和党选举得票增长，符合经济投票逻辑；（2）但通胀对总统投票份额存在超出纯经济投票之外的额外关联效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将通胀与实际工资效应区分开来，丰富了经济投票理论的内涵；揭示了通胀作为独立经济信号对选举的额外影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和竞选策略提供参考：选民对实际收入的感知比名义通胀更敏感，但通胀本身也是独立的政治信号。

title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Field Experiments to Explore Novel Features of Parental Speech and Foster Child Development
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Chicago - Department of Economics, , University of Chicago, Independent, Independent and University of Chicago

detail.title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Field Experiments to Explore Novel Features of Parental Speech and Foster Child Development

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Parents play a critical role in shaping children’s skills during the first years of life. Yet, identifying the contributors to richer learning environments remains difficult due to various unobservable factors. In this paper, we combine field experiments with AI to explore new acoustic features of parental speech. Specifically, we develop a signal processing model that uses more than 600 hours of recorded parent-child interactions combined with assessment data from two home-visiting experiments conducted in the Chicagoland area to identify features of parental speech that map into children’s skills. Our two experiments consist of the same intervention helping parents provide nurturing interactions to their child. We exploit the experimental and natural variation in our data to explore two causal channels and one potential moderator. First, our intervention improves parental speech consistently across the two studies, as measured by acoustic features that are predictive of higher socioemotional skills and adult-child conversational turns. Further, we find that it also increases children’s language skills in both experiments, as well as socioemotional skills in the second experiment. Interestingly, our heterogeneity analyses reveal that some of the interventions’ impacts vary by socioeconomic groups, with patterns across the two experiments suggesting that the mechanisms are context-dependent.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文结合实地实验与AI信号处理技术，基于600多小时亲子互动录音数据，识别父母言语的声学特征对儿童技能发展的影响，发现干预措施能改善父母言语模式并提升儿童语言和社会情感技能，且效果因社会经济群体和情境而异。
AI.research_question: 父母言语的声学特征如何影响儿童技能发展？基于AI的声学特征能否揭示家庭学习环境差异的因果机制？
AI.motivation: 父母在儿童早期发展中扮演关键角色，但识别促进更丰富学习环境的因素存在诸多不可观测变量，传统方法难以厘清因果机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童早期发展理论、亲子互动理论、言语声学特征与技能发展的映射关系
AI.method: 结合两项芝加哥地区的家访实地实验数据（600多小时亲子互动录音），运用信号处理模型提取父母言语的声学特征，利用实验变异和自然变异识别因果渠道。
AI.findings: 1) 干预措施一致改善了父母言语的声学特征（预测更高社会情感技能和亲子对话轮换）；2) 干预提升了儿童语言技能（两项实验均显著）和社会情感技能（第二项实验显著）；3) 干预效果因社会经济群体而异，机制具有情境依赖性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI声学分析引入儿童早期发展研究，提出新的父母言语声学特征作为可测量的因果渠道，拓展了对家庭学习环境异质性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期儿童干预项目提供基于声学特征的可量化评估指标，揭示不同社会经济群体需要差异化干预策略，有助于提升育儿支持政策的精准性。

title:
Institutional Architecture, Economic Vulnerability, and Household Resilience

Exploring the Relationship between the MILEI-friendly Index and Socio-Economic Indicators in the European Union

detail.title:
Institutional Architecture, Economic Vulnerability, and Household Resilience

Exploring the Relationship between the MILEI-friendly Index and Socio-Economic Indicators in the European Union

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants or personal data were involved in this research. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This reserch received no external funding

detail.abstract:
This paper explores the relationship between institutional architecture for micro-entrepreneurs and indicators of economic vulnerability and household resilience across the European Union. Building upon the previously developed MILEI-friendly Index (Micro-Independent Labor & Enterprise Institutional Index), the study investigates whether institutional adaptability toward micro-scale economic actors is associated with differences in poverty risk, distributive inequality, and household income dynamics.

The analysis combines MILEI calibration data for all 27 EU member states with standard socio-economic indicators, including the Gini coefficient, the S80/S20 income ratio, the at-risk-of-poverty rate, and household disposable income growth. Unlike conventional approaches that examine taxes, social contributions, and administrative obligations separately, the present study interprets institutional burden as a cumulative structure of obligatory outflows required for maintaining economic participation.

Preliminary findings suggest that the relationship between institutional adaptability and aggregate inequality indicators remains limited. However, more adaptive institutional systems appear more consistently associated with lower levels of poverty risk and more favorable household income dynamics. These findings indicate that institutional architecture may influence not the overall distribution of income itself, but rather the resilience capacity of economically vulnerable groups operating under conditions of unstable income and limited capital reserves.

The paper does not attempt to establish causal inference. Instead, it proposes an exploratory institutional framework for examining how cumulative institutional burden may contribute to structural economic vulnerability. By operationalizing institutional exposure through an integrated comparative index, the study contributes to the emerging literature on institutional economics, self-employment vulnerability, and economic resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文基于MILEI友好指数，探究欧盟27国微型创业者的制度架构与经济脆弱性及家庭韧性的关系，发现制度适应性更强与较低的贫困风险和更有利的家庭收入动态相关，但不影响整体收入分配。
AI.research_question: 欧盟各国面向微型创业者的制度架构与经济脆弱性（贫困风险、分配不平等、家庭收入动态）之间存在怎样的关联？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将税收、社会缴款和行政义务分开考察，忽视了制度负担作为维持经济参与所需的累积性强制支出的整体结构效应。本文试图从累积制度负担的角度，探索制度架构如何影响微型创业者的经济韧性和脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学、自我就业脆弱性理论、经济韧性理论。核心概念为"累积制度负担"（cumulative institutional burden）——维持经济参与所需的一系列强制性支出构成的整体结构。
AI.method: 将MILEI友好指数（校准数据）与27个欧盟成员国的社会经济指标（基尼系数、S80/S20收入比、贫困风险率、家庭可支配收入增长）进行组合分析，采用探索性而非因果推断的研究设计。
AI.findings: （1）制度适应性与总体不平等指标（基尼系数、收入比）之间的关联有限；（2）制度适应性更强的系统与更低的贫困风险和更有利的家庭收入动态更为一致地相关；（3）制度架构可能不影响总体收入分配，而是影响经济脆弱群体的韧性能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"累积制度负担"这一整合性分析框架，将制度环境对微观经济主体的影响作为一个整体结构来考察；通过综合比较指数将制度暴露程度操作化，丰富了制度经济学、自我就业脆弱性和经济韧性的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了制度设计如何影响微型创业者贫困风险和收入韧性的经验证据，提示政策应关注制度架构对脆弱群体的差异化影响，而非仅仅关注总体不平等指标。

title: Contrastive Semantic Analysis of Startup Pitches: Identifying Linguistic Hype Traps and Vaporware in Emerging Markets (2015-2026)

detail.title: Contrastive Semantic Analysis of Startup Pitches: Identifying Linguistic Hype Traps and Vaporware in Emerging Markets (2015-2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human or animal participants. The research relies entirely on the computational analysis of publicly available corporate text and startup pitch descriptions. No sensitive, patient, or identifiable personal data was utilized.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Private equity valuations in emerging markets heavily reflect narrative momentum. Investors rarely see hard revenue data during early seed rounds. They buy text. We built a Contrastive Learning model to mathematically isolate marketing vaporware from actual proprietary engineering in Pakistan. We processed 500 verified pitches spanning 2015 to 2026. We constructed a strict semantic divergence index. This equation measures the frequency of generic marketing buzzwords against verifiable technical vocabulary. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) projections reveal a massive empirical gap. A massive volume of basic e-commerce applications actively utilized deep tech jargon to mask their lack of scientific infrastructure. This framework gives institutional capital an algorithmic weapon. They can instantly separate semantic noise from true innovation. Our 2D latent space isolation proves that over 80% of regional startups operated purely on marketing semantics, leaving a minuscule fraction executing valid hardware or algorithmic breakthroughs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比学习模型分析巴基斯坦初创企业融资文本，发现超过80%的初创公司依赖营销话术而非真实技术能力，构建了语义散度指数来区分"营销泡沫"与"真实工程创新"。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场私募股权估值如何受叙事动量影响？能否通过算法手段区分初创企业融资材料中的营销话术与真实技术能力？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场早期初创企业缺乏硬性营收数据，投资人主要依赖文本材料做决策，而大量企业用深科技术语包装低技术含量项目，导致资本错配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对比学习（Contrastive Learning）、主成分分析（PCA）、语义散度指数（Semantic Divergence Index）
AI.method: 构建对比学习模型，处理2015-2026年间500份巴基斯坦初创企业融资 pitch 材料，通过语义散度指数量化通用营销词汇与可验证技术词汇的频率差异，利用PCA进行二维潜在空间投影分析。
AI.findings: 超过80%的区域初创企业完全依靠营销语义运营，仅有极少数企业执行了有效的硬件或算法突破；大量基础电商应用用深科技术语掩盖其缺乏科学基础设施的事实。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将对比学习应用于新兴市场初创企业估值文本分析，提出了可量化的语义散度指数框架，为"叙事经济学"提供了算法化的实证工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构资本提供了识别"营销泡沫"与"真实创新"的算法武器，可帮助投资者在早期阶段规避话术陷阱，优化新兴市场的资本配置效率。

title: Predicting Venture Capital Funding via Causal NLP: Lexical Richness and Syntactic Verbosity Indicators in Emerging Markets (2015-2026)

detail.title: Predicting Venture Capital Funding via Causal NLP: Lexical Richness and Syntactic Verbosity Indicators in Emerging Markets (2015-2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human or animal participants. The research relies entirely on the computational analysis of publicly available corporate text and startup pitch descriptions. No sensitive, patient, or identifiable personal data was utilized.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Pre-seed venture capital lacks hard financial metrics. Investors rely on intuition. They read text and guess. We propose a Causal Natural Language Processing framework to kill the guesswork. We predict startup viability using absolute syntactic structures. We stripped sentiment entirely. Analyzing 500 Pakistani startups spanning 2015 to 2026, we extracted word count density and Lexical Richness (Type-Token Ratio) as core causal features. Linear regression proves a massive, statistically undeniable negative correlation between pitch verbosity and seed funding success. Hard science demands tight syntax. Verbosity signals a weak product. Unfunded founders write long, rambling sentences filled with redundant adjectives to hide their lack of technology. Successfully funded founders write short, highly specific data points. We deployed a logistic classifier that screens startups based strictly on mathematical syntax. Institutional investors can use this exact algorithm to instantly reject weak pitches, eliminating subjective human bias from the early-stage allocation pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果自然语言处理（Causal NLP）的框架，通过分析创业公司 pitch 的绝对句法结构（如词数密度和词汇丰富度）来预测其可行性，彻底剔除情感分析。基于500家巴基斯坦初创企业（2015-2026年）的数据，线性回归显示 pitch 的冗长程度与种子轮融资成功率存在显著的负相关。最终构建的逻辑分类器可帮助机构投资者基于数学句法筛选项目，消除主观偏见。
AI.research_question: 能否通过创业公司 pitch 的绝对句法结构（而非情感或语义）客观预测其种子轮融资成功概率？
AI.motivation: 种子轮风险投资缺乏硬性财务指标，投资者只能依赖直觉和文本阅读进行判断，存在严重的主观偏差。为了消除猜疑，作者希望用因果NLP框架提供可量化的科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果自然语言处理（Causal NLP）、绝对句法结构分析、词汇丰富度（Type-Token Ratio）、词数密度、线性回归与逻辑分类器。
AI.method: 1) 数据：500家巴基斯坦初创企业（2015-2026年）的 pitch 文本。2) 特征提取：词数密度和词汇丰富度（Type-Token Ratio）作为核心因果特征，完全剥离情感特征。3) 模型：线性回归验证负相关关系；逻辑分类器用于实际筛选。
AI.findings: pitch 的冗长程度（长句、冗余形容词）与种子轮融资成功存在显著的统计负相关。成功获得融资的创始人倾向于写短句、高信息密度的具体数据点；未获融资的创始人则用冗长、散漫的句子掩饰技术不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出用绝对句法结构（而非语义或情感）作为创业公司可行性的因果预测指标，为创业融资领域提供了基于硬科学（硬句法）的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了一套可即时运行的算法筛选工具，能够基于数学句法自动拒绝弱质 pitch，消除早期投资分配中的人类主观偏见。

title: The Objective of the Firm, Higher Purpose and Financial Performance
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: The Objective of the Firm, Higher Purpose and Financial Performance
detail.abstract:
I develop an optimal contracting model to address mixed empirical evidence on how organizational
higher purpose affects financial performance. There are three main results. First, while purpose-driven
employees and firms generate higher productive effort, pure profit-maximizers perform better financially
in pooling equilibria where firm identities are shrouded. In separating equilibria, purpose-driven firms
may financially outperform profit maximizers and generate higher pecuniary output. Second, separating
equilibria produce higher social welfare in some circumstances, but social stigma against non-purpose-
driven firms can induce identity shrouding via purpose washing, generating inefficient pooling. Third,
adding employees who are not purpose-driven may improve welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个最优契约模型，研究企业崇高使命对财务绩效的混合实证证据。主要发现：在混同均衡中，纯粹利润最大化企业财务表现更好；在分离均衡中，使命驱动型企业可能财务表现更优；社会污名可能导致"使命粉饰"；引入非使命驱动型员工可能改善社会福利。
AI.research_question: 组织崇高使命如何影响企业财务绩效？在不同的信息结构（混同均衡 vs 分离均衡）下，使命驱动型企业和纯利润最大化企业谁更可能取得更好的财务表现？
AI.motivation: 现有关于企业崇高使命与财务绩效之间关系的实证证据存在混合结论，缺乏统一的理论框架来解释这些矛盾发现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优契约模型（Optimal Contracting Model）、信号博弈（Signaling Game）、均衡分析（混同均衡与分离均衡）
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈论分析，构建包含使命驱动型员工/企业与非使命驱动型员工/企业的最优契约模型，分析不同信息结构下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1) 在混同均衡中，纯利润最大化企业财务表现更好；在分离均衡中，使命驱动型企业可能财务表现更优。2) 分离均衡在某些情况下社会福利更高，但针对非使命驱动型企业的社会污名会通过"使命粉饰"导致身份混淆，产生低效混同。3) 引入非使命驱动型员工可能反而改善社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 为混合的实证证据提供了统一的理论解释框架；揭示了信息结构（混同 vs 分离均衡）在理解使命与绩效关系中的关键作用；首次从理论层面分析了"使命粉饰"（purpose washing）现象及其福利后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供启示：使命驱动型企业在信息透明时才能发挥财务优势；警示社会污名可能导致企业伪装使命而非真正践行；提示企业招聘时需考虑员工-使命匹配的复杂性。

affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.abstract: This paper argues that the mass entry of women into the American paid workforce between approximately 1965 and 1985 produced a structural, permanent repricing of the cost of living that has been systematically overlooked in the macroeconomic literature. Distinct from conventional inflation-which operates cyclically and can be managed through monetary policy-the labor supply shock of second-wave feminism triggered a one-time reset of the economic baseline: the minimum household income required to sustain a middle-class standard of living. Evidence is drawn from historical price-to-income ratios for housing, real wage stagnation data, labor force participation records from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, and crosscountry comparisons across OECD economies. The paper situates its argument in relation to Warren and Tyagi's (2003) identification of the dual-income bidding war mechanism, extending their analysis to identify the labor supply shock as the causal trigger and the permanent baseline reset as its structural legacy. The central finding is that the standard of living accessible to a single-income household in 1965 now requires two incomes-not as a consequence of cyclical inflation, but as a consequence of a structural recalibration of all positional goods markets around dual-income purchasing capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文论证1965-1985年间美国女性大规模进入有偿劳动力市场，导致生活成本的永久性结构性重置，而非周期性通胀。这一劳动力供给冲击使得维持中产阶级生活水平所需的最低家庭收入从单收入转变为双收入。
AI.research_question: 女性大规模进入劳动力市场是否以及如何导致了生活成本的永久性结构性重定价？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济学文献系统性地忽视了第二次女权主义浪潮带来的劳动力供给冲击对生活成本的永久性影响，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Warren和Tyagi（2003）的双收入竞价机制理论，将其扩展为劳动力供给冲击作为因果触发因素、永久性基线重置作为结构性遗产的分析框架。
AI.method: 历史房价收入比、实际工资停滞数据、美国劳工统计局劳动力参与率记录，以及OECD跨国比较分析。
AI.findings: 1965年单收入家庭可负担的生活水平如今需要双收入才能实现；这不是周期性通胀的结果，而是所有位置性商品市场围绕双收入购买力进行的结构性重新校准。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"周期性通胀"与"结构性基线重置"两种不同的价格变动机制；将女权主义浪潮的劳动力供给冲击识别为生活成本变化的因果触发因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示宏观经济政策制定者应关注结构性劳动力供给变化对生活成本的长期影响，而非仅关注周期性通胀管理。

title: Redesigning AI Regulatory Sandboxes for Generative AI: Beyond Traditional for-Profit Innovation
affiliations: , Cornell University - Department of Information Science and Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB)

detail.title: Redesigning AI Regulatory Sandboxes for Generative AI: Beyond Traditional for-Profit Innovation
detail.abstract: Regulatory sandboxes have become a central instrument for governing artificial intelligence (AI), with data protection authorities and AI regulations frameworks increasingly relying on them to enable regulatory learning and promote innovation. However, in this paper, we argue that current sandbox frameworks do not adequately account for AI innovation occurring outside of the for-profit space. As vibe coding, AI agents, and zero-code platforms have lowered the technical thresholds for building and deploying AI applications, public sector institutions, civil society organizations, and non-institutional innovators are increasingly in roles that data protection and AI regulations have traditionally assigned to firms. Yet in conducting a scoping review of AI-related sandboxes across jurisdictions in Europe, Latin America, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, we find several barriers to participation by these actors. In addition to often explicitly limiting sandbox participation to private sector actors, eligibility criteria and participant recruitment processes place implicit barriers as they assume organisational capacity that public sector, civil society, and individual innovators typically do not possess. Drawing from literature in innovation studies, data protection and AI law, and experimental governance, we argue that this bias against non-market actors limits the capacity for socially beneficial innovations to emerge. To go beyond market-driven approaches to regulatory learning and innovation, we conclude by proposing three main pathways for more inclusive sandbox design, including low-friction entry points, intermediated participation, and eligibility criteria oriented toward societal value.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前AI监管沙盒框架主要面向营利性企业，忽视了公共部门、民间社会组织和非机构创新者等非市场主体的参与，导致社会有益创新的潜力受限，并提出了更具包容性的沙盒设计路径。
AI.research_question: 当前的AI监管沙盒框架是否充分容纳了非营利领域的AI创新？非市场行为者在参与监管沙盒时面临哪些障碍？如何设计更具包容性的沙盒以促进社会有益创新？
AI.motivation: 随着"氛围编程"、AI代理和零代码平台降低了AI应用的技术门槛，越来越多的公共部门、公民社会和非机构创新者参与到AI创新中。然而，现有的监管沙盒主要面向私营企业设计，可能系统性排除这些非市场行为者，从而限制了监管学习和创新促进的广度与深度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新研究、数据保护与AI法律、实验治理（experimental governance）
AI.method: 对欧洲、拉丁美洲、亚洲、非洲和中东地区的AI相关监管沙盒进行范围综述（scoping review）
AI.findings: 1) 许多沙盒明确将参与限于私营部门；2) 资格标准和参与者招募流程隐含地假设了非市场行为者通常不具备的组织能力，形成隐性壁垒；3) 这种对非市场行为者的偏见限制了社会有益创新的涌现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创新研究、数据保护/AI法律与实验治理的理论视角交叉，揭示了监管沙盒设计中存在的非市场偏见，拓展了对监管学习与创新促进关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三条包容性沙盒设计路径：低摩擦入口点、中介式参与、面向社会价值的资格标准，为政策制定者和监管机构提供了可操作的设计建议。

title:
Financial Depth and Macroeconomic Volatility under Trade Shock: 
A Cross-Country Analysis
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics, New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics,  and New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics

detail.title:
Financial Depth and Macroeconomic Volatility under Trade Shock: 
A Cross-Country Analysis
detail.abstract: This study examines whether financial depth dampens or amplifies macroeconomic volatility using annual panel data from 86 countries over 2000-2024, estimated with two-way fixed effects and Driscoll-Kraay standard errors. Across the full sample, deeper financial systems measured by Broad Money to GDP are associated with lower output volatility. It supports the finance stabilization hypothesis, though no nonlinear turning point is found. However, this stabilizing role is highly conditional, as elevated inflation significantly weakens financial depth's buffering capacity, particularly in advanced economies, while trade shocks increase volatility primarily in emerging markets where financial depth does not significantly mitigate their transmission. Heterogeneity across income groups is substantial, with financial depth consistently reducing volatility in advanced economies, while exchange rate movements and trade shocks are the dominant drivers of instability in emerging markets. These findings suggest that financial depth is a relevant but conditional stabilization tool, and that effective macroeconomic stabilization requires a broader policy framework encompassing low inflation, sustainable fiscal positions, and sound external balance management.

AI.tldr: 基于86国2000-2024年面板数据，研究发现金融深化（广义货币/GDP）总体上降低产出波动，支持金融稳定假说，但这种稳定作用高度依赖于低通胀环境，且在不同收入水平国家中存在显著异质性。
AI.research_question: 金融深化是抑制还是放大宏观经济波动？其作用在不同国家和经济条件下是否存在条件性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对金融发展与宏观经济波动的关系存在争议（稳定效应 vs. 放大效应），且缺乏对条件异质性的系统考察，本研究旨在提供更全面的跨国经验证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融稳定假说（Finance Stabilization Hypothesis）；非线性效应理论；宏观经济波动传导机制理论
AI.method: 采用86个国家2000-2024年年度面板数据，使用双向固定效应模型（Two-way Fixed Effects）估计，并结合Driscoll-Kraay标准误处理截面相依和异方差问题。
AI.findings: （1）全样本下金融深化（广义货币/GDP）显著降低产出波动，支持金融稳定假说，未发现非线性转折点；（2）高通胀显著削弱金融深化的稳定作用，尤其在发达经济体中；（3）贸易冲击主要在新兴市场增加波动，金融深化无法有效缓解其传导；（4）发达经济体中金融深化持续降低波动，而新兴市场波动主要由汇率变动和贸易冲击驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了金融稳定假说但揭示了其强条件性，识别了通胀作为关键调节变量，丰富了金融发展与宏观经济稳定关系的条件性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了差异化政策建议：金融深化作为稳定工具需配合低通胀环境；发达经济体与新兴市场需采取不同的宏观稳定策略，需构建包含低通胀、可持续财政和外部平衡管理的综合政策框架。

title:
Patrick Schotanus, The Market Mind Hypothesis: Understanding Markets and Minds through Cognitive
Economics. Berlin/Boston: Walter De Gruyter (2023)

detail.title:
Patrick Schotanus, The Market Mind Hypothesis: Understanding Markets and Minds through Cognitive
Economics. Berlin/Boston: Walter De Gruyter (2023)

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Review of Austrian Economics, volume 38, issue 4, 2025[10.1007/s11138-024-00650-6]

detail.abstract: A book review of Patrick Schotanus' The Market Mind Hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇对Patrick Schotanus《市场心智假说》的书评。
AI.research_question: 该书提出的核心问题是：市场是否可以被理解为具有某种"心智"或认知能力的实体？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论将市场视为完全理性的机械系统，作者试图挑战这一范式，提出市场具有类似于人类心智的认知特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场心智假说（Market Mind Hypothesis, MMH），整合了认知科学、复杂系统理论和行为金融学。
AI.method: 书评形式，对该书的核心论点、理论框架和学术贡献进行梳理与评述。
AI.findings: 该书认为市场不是无意识的机械系统，而是一个具有集体认知能力的"心智"实体，能够感知、处理和响应信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统有效市场假说和理性预期理论，为理解市场行为提供了认知科学视角的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者理解市场非理性行为、市场情绪和集体决策提供了新的理论工具。

title: Policy Effects of Limiting Independent Directors’ Multiple Directorships: Evidence from China
affiliations: Jinan University, Jinan University, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Policy Effects of Limiting Independent Directors’ Multiple Directorships: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: Whether independent directors’ busyness impairs their effectiveness remains controversial. Chinese regulators therefore tightened the cap on the number of board seats an independent director may hold. Using a many-to-many assortative matching model and 2,300 matched “listed company–independent director” observations from China’s A-share market in 2020, we find that reducing the maximum number of positions increases the utility of both firms and independent directors on average. Random forest predictions indicate improvements in firms’ regulatory compliance, information disclosure, and internal control quality. However, about 30% of firms and independent directors experience a decline in utility, and roughly 5.06%–44.89% of firms exhibit worse governance outcomes. We also document spillover effects on non-treated but non-regulated firms and directors, driven by a quantity effect (e.g., director shortages) and a substitution effect (e.g., weaker qualifications). Updating the independent director database and shifting accounting directors to non-overlapping workplaces can mitigate these adverse effects.

AI.tldr: 通过匹配模型和随机森林预测，研究发现中国收紧独立董事任职上限平均提升了企业和董事的效用，但约30%的群体效用下降，且存在溢出效应，可通过更新数据库和调整会计董事任职来缓解负面影响。
AI.research_question: 独立董事的繁忙是否损害其有效性？收紧独立董事兼任席位上限的政策产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 独立董事繁忙（过多兼任）是否影响其履职有效性存在争议，中国监管机构因此收紧了对独立董事可兼任董事会席位数量的限制，本文旨在评估该政策的效果及其潜在副作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多对多 assortative matching（分类匹配）模型、随机森林预测、量效应与替代效应（溢出机制）
AI.method: 使用多对多分类匹配模型和2020年中国A股市场2,300个匹配的“上市公司-独立董事”观测样本，结合随机森林预测进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）降低任职上限平均提高了企业和独立董事的效用；（2）改善了公司合规性、信息披露和内控质量；（3）但约30%的企业和董事效用下降，约5.06%-44.89%的公司治理结果恶化；（4）存在对未受监管直接影响的公司和董事的溢出效应，主要通过量效应（董事短缺）和替代效应（资格较弱）传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 为独立董事繁忙效应的争议提供了新证据，揭示了监管干预的平均获益与异质性负面后果并存，并识别了溢出效应的两种传导机制（量效应与替代效应）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估和优化独立董事兼职限制政策提供实证依据；建议更新独立董事数据库、将会计背景董事安排至非重叠任职单位以缓解政策负面效应。

title: The Post-2015 German Lending Surge What Role for QE?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Post-2015 German Lending Surge What Role for QE?
detail.abstract: This paper uses German microdata to test whether the ECB’s quantitative easing (QE) spurred bank lending to non-financial firms. Bank-firm loan data allow me to control for loan demand at firm level. The share of bonds in banks’ total assets before QE serves as treatment proxy. While the effects are positive and statistically significant, they are small: Increasing the bond/asset share in a firm’s lender bank by one standard deviation increases the de-trended outstanding bilateral loan volume by 3-5% of its within-sample mean. At firm level, no unambiguous effect can be observed.

AI.tldr: 本文利用德国微观数据研究欧央行量化宽松政策对银行向非金融企业贷款的影响，发现效果虽统计显著但规模较小。
AI.research_question: 欧央行的量化宽松政策是否刺激了银行对非金融企业的贷款？
AI.motivation: 量化宽松政策的效果备受争议，尤其是其对实体经济信贷传导渠道的影响需要微观层面的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量化宽松通过银行资产负债表渠道（债券持有比例变化）影响银行放贷行为。
AI.method: 使用德国银行-企业层面的贷款数据，以量化宽松前银行债券占总资产比例作为处理代理变量，通过控制企业层面的贷款需求来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）量化宽松对银行贷款的影响在统计上显著但经济规模较小：银行债券资产比例每增加一个标准差，双边贷款余额（去趋势后）增加样本均值的3-5%；（2）在企业层面未观察到明确一致的效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为量化宽松的信贷传导渠道提供了微观层面的因果证据，揭示了该效应的边界条件（显著但微弱）。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者而言，表明量化宽松对实体经济的信贷刺激作用可能有限，需要辅以其他政策工具。

title: The Power of Position: Display Salience in Specialized ETFs

detail.title: The Power of Position: Display Salience in Specialized ETFs
detail.abstract: Exchange-traded fund (ETF) providers display the top 10 holdings on a visually distinct, above-the-fold panel of the fund's information page. In specialized ETFs, where these stocks are likely to be read as representative of the fund's theme, we show that this disclosure convention generates a display salience effect: top 10 constituents attract heightened retail attention, experience larger increases in retail ownership, and earn cumulative abnormal returns 1.57% above other constituents around fund inception. The price gain, however, is temporary, with a significant portion of the initial gain reversing over the following months. The effect is concentrated specifically at the rank-10 visibility cutoff and is not driven by firm size or other stock characteristics. The results indicate that standard features of ETF portfolio disclosure can move retail attention and generate temporary deviations in constituent stock prices.

AI.tldr: ETF提供商在信息页面的醒目位置展示前十大持仓，这种披露惯例产生了"展示显著性效应"：排名前10的成份股吸引了更多散户关注、散户持股比例上升，并在基金成立初期获得高于其他成份股1.57%的累计异常收益，但这种价格效应是暂时的，随后会发生反转。该效应集中在第10名这一可见性临界点，并非由公司规模等因素驱动。
AI.research_question: ETF前十大持仓的突出展示惯例是否会影响散户投资者的注意力分配和交易行为，进而导致成份股价格出现暂时性偏离？
AI.motivation: ETF提供商会将前十持仓以醒目的方式单独展示在信息页面上，这种披露设计可能使这些股票被投资者解读为基金主题的代表，从而产生注意力偏差和价格效应，但此前缺乏对此的系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 展示显著性效应（display salience effect）；注意力驱动交易理论；零售投资者有限注意力理论。
AI.method: 利用ETF成立事件，对比前十成份股与其他成份股在散户关注度、散户持股比例和累计异常收益上的差异，并聚焦第10名临界点的断点效应进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）前十成份股吸引更多散户关注，散户持股比例增长更大；（2）前十成份股在基金成立初期获得1.57%的累计异常收益；（3）价格效应是暂时的，后续发生显著反转；（4）效应集中在排名第10的可见性临界点，且非由公司规模等因素驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了ETF信息披露的标准化惯例（前十大持仓展示）对投资者注意力和资产价格的因果影响，拓展了有限注意力和注意力驱动交易领域的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 对ETF提供商和监管机构具有启示意义：信息展示方式的设计会影响市场效率和投资者行为，需关注披露格式可能带来的价格扭曲效应。

title: Structure and Resolution in Banking: Are They Substitutes
affiliations: University of Kent - School of Economics and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Structure and Resolution in Banking: Are They Substitutes
detail.abstract: Can bank resolution replace ring-fencing? We develop a simple framework ofexpected systemic loss in which structural separability and resolvability interact.When either of two features holds—structure makes resolution work better, or itreduces the support needed during failure—resolution and ring-fencing becomecomplements, not substitutes. Contrary to conventional wisdom, as the credibilityof using resolution rises, the optimal degree of ring-fencing often increases; easing iswarranted only in knife-edge cases where structure brings no marginal benefit. Aprivate–social comparison predicts under-investment in structure and preparedness.In general, better resolvability strengthens the case for ring-fencing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了银行破产处置机制（resolution）与结构性隔离（ring-fencing）之间的关系。通过构建预期系统性损失模型，发现两者并非替代关系，而是互补关系——当结构性隔离能提升处置有效性或减少失败时所需支持时，两者互补性增强。处置可信度提高时，最优隔离程度往往上升，仅在极端情况下才应放松隔离。私人-社会比较显示市场对结构和准备的投资不足。
AI.research_question: 银行破产处置机制能否取代结构性隔离？两者是替代关系还是互补关系？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，随着银行处置能力（resolvability）的提升，结构性隔离的必要性会下降，两者是替代关系。本文质疑这一传统智慧，试图从理论上阐明两者可能存在的互补关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期系统性损失框架模型，分析结构性分离（structural separability）与处置可行性（resolvability）之间的交互作用。
AI.method: 理论建模——构建预期系统性损失的简单分析框架。
AI.findings: （1）处置与隔离在特定条件下是互补品而非替代品；（2）处置可信度提高时，最优隔离程度往往上升；（3）放松隔离仅在结构不带来边际收益的极端情况下才合理；（4）私人-社会比较显示市场对结构和准备投资不足；（5）更好的处置可行性反而加强了隔离的必要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战并修正了传统观点中处置与隔离是替代关系的认知，建立了两者互补关系的理论框架；揭示了处置能力提升反而可能强化隔离必要性的反直觉结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行监管政策制定提供指导：不应因处置机制完善就轻易放松结构性隔离要求；政策制定者应关注市场对结构和准备投资的不足问题。

title:
The Two-fairness Distinction: 
Evidence for the Separability of Preference-based Prosociality, Attitudinal Trust, and Institutional Quality

detail.title:
The Two-fairness Distinction: 
Evidence for the Separability of Preference-based Prosociality, Attitudinal Trust, and Institutional Quality
detail.abstract:
Cross-cultural research conflates three empirically distinct constructs: preference-based
prosociality (GPS F_proxy), attitudinal social trust (WVS/ESS), and institutional quality
(CPI/GDP). We term their separability the Two-Fairness Distinction and test it across eight
independent datasets (GPS N=80,337; ESS Rounds 1–11; six additional sources; 76 countries; 20
years). F_proxy is near-zero correlated with institutional quality (CPI: r=−0.023, CI [−0.27, +0.23];
lnGDP: r=−0.018) — a pattern that survives multivariate controls, jackknife diagnostics, and five
composite specifications. Associations with attitudinal trust vary by sample: near-zero in European
ESS surveys (meta-r=+0.118, p=.137) and weakly positive globally (GPS trust: r=+0.227, p=.049).
By contrast, patience strongly predicts institutional quality (r=+0.725***) and wealth
(r=+0.580***) but not F_proxy. Behavioral community bond strength (B_social) is the only
consistent predictor of F_proxy (meta-r=+0.374***, I²=0%, k=11 ESS rounds, 2002–2022;
longitudinal: CLPM β=+0.101, p=.002; Khan, 2026b). The findings support construct separability
but do not establish causal independence. All analyses are exploratory; a preregistered confirmatory
replication (WVS Wave 8, OSF: osf.io/fxhmc) is planned.

AI.tldr: 本文通过八个独立数据集（N=80,337，76个国家，20年数据）证明：偏好性亲社会行为、态度性社会信任与制度质量是三个经验上可分离的构念（"双公平区分"）。F_proxy与制度质量几乎零相关（r≈-0.02），与态度信任相关性弱且不稳定；耐心显著预测制度质量和财富但不预测F_proxy；社群联结强度是F_proxy唯一一致的预测因子（r=+0.374***）。
AI.research_question: 跨文化研究中常被混用的三个构念——偏好性亲社会行为（GPS F_proxy）、态度性社会信任（WVS/ESS）和制度质量（CPI/GDP）——是否在经验上可分离？
AI.motivation: 现有跨文化研究常将亲社会性、信任和制度质量混为一谈，但缺乏系统性证据检验三者是否真的是同一潜在构念的不同表现，还是彼此独立的维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: "双公平区分"（Two-Fairness Distinction）：偏好性亲社会行为（涉及公平偏好、利他惩罚等行为经济学构念）、态度性社会信任（主观信任态度）与制度质量（客观制度环境）应被视为三个分离的构念。
AI.method: 八项独立数据集分析：GPS数据（N=80,337）、ESS第1-11轮、六项额外来源；覆盖76个国家、20年跨度。采用相关分析、多变量控制、jackknife诊断、五种复合指标规格、元分析及纵向交叉滞后面板模型（CLPM）。
AI.findings: 1) F_proxy与制度质量近乎零相关（CPI: r=-0.023; lnGDP: r=-0.018），稳健于多种规格；2) 与态度信任的相关性因样本而异（ESS: 近乎零；GPS: 弱正相关r=+0.227）；3) 耐心显著预测制度质量（r=+0.725***）和财富（r=+0.580***）但不预测F_proxy；4) 社群联结强度是唯一一致预测F_proxy的变量（元分析r=+0.374***，I²=0%，CLPM β=+0.101, p=.002）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地从经验层面证明偏好性亲社会行为、态度性社会信任与制度质量是三个分离构念，挑战了将它们混为一谈的传统跨文化研究范式，提出了"双公平区分"这一理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨文化政策制定提供启示：提升制度质量（如反腐、法治）不能简单等同于促进个体亲社会行为或社会信任；促进社群联结可能是增强亲社会行为的有效干预途径。

title: The Verification Rate Gap: A Conceptual Metric for AI Development Risk

detail.title: The Verification Rate Gap: A Conceptual Metric for AI Development Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Representative Director of C3 Social Design Center and maintains the public companion repository related to the Verification Kit architecture discussed in this Research Note. The paper presents a conceptual and architectural framework and does not report sponsored empirical results, product certification, or production deployment. The author declares no other personal or financial relationships that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This Research Note does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, animal subjects, or clinical intervention. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
As AI systems increasingly automate parts of their own development, the primary bottleneck of safety and oversight shifts from the capacity of the AI system to the capacity of the verifier. This paper proposes the Verification Rate Gap as a conceptual metric for AI development risk. The core claim is simple: risk emerges when the rate of AI-generated development outputs exceeds the rate at which those outputs can be reliably verified.

We define AI development risk as a function of the discrepancy between Generation Rate (G_rate) and Verification Rate (V_rate): R_dev ∝ max(0, G_rate − V_rate). When generation accelerates while verification remains bounded by human review, systems accumulate unverified debt: AI-generated code, experiments, evaluations, decisions, or system changes that have not yet been reproduced, audited, or challenged. A separate bounded triage rate (T_rate) can make unverified debt visible, but only verified clearance through V_rate reduces the debt stock.

To reduce this gap, this paper introduces the Verification Kit: a standardized evidence package containing execution manifests, verdict records, evidence digests, conformance results, undefined-case reports, and integrity proofs. The Kit shifts verification from informal human review toward mechanical replay and structured audit. Its purpose is not to guarantee absolute safety or alignment, but to increase verification throughput by making decision paths reproducible, inspectable, and challengeable by third parties or independent verification tools.

The paper defines the claim boundary of this approach and discusses three failure modes: circular specification authority, adversarial audit trails, and the difficulty of deterministic replay in stochastic AI systems. The conclusion is that governance for AI-built-AI workflows should treat verification throughput as a first-class safety requirement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"验证速率差距"概念，认为AI开发风险源于AI生成输出的速率超过可被可靠验证的速率。为缩小这一差距，作者提出"验证工具包"（Verification Kit）——一套标准化证据包，旨在将验证从非正式人工审查转向机械重放和结构化审计，从而提高验证吞吐量。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统越来越多地自动化自身开发过程时，如何量化和降低因生成速率超过验证速率而产生的AI开发风险？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统自主开发能力增强，安全与监督的主要瓶颈从AI系统的能力转向验证者的能力。当前缺乏一个概念性指标来衡量这种不匹配带来的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险函数 R_dev ∝ max(0, G_rate − V_rate)，即开发风险与生成速率和验证速率的正差距成正比。引入"未验证债务"（unverified debt）概念，以及分流速率（T_rate）和验证清除（verified clearance）的存量-流量逻辑。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建。提出Verification Kit标准化证据包，包含执行清单、裁决记录、证据摘要、一致性结果、未定义案例报告和完整性证明。
AI.findings: 当生成加速而验证受限于人工审查时，系统会积累未验证债务。Verification Kit通过使决策路径可复现、可检查、可质疑来提高验证吞吐量。但该方法存在三个失败模式：循环规范权威、对抗性审计轨迹、随机AI系统中确定性重放的困难。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"验证速率差距"这一概念性度量，将AI开发风险形式化为生成速率与验证速率之间的函数，并引入"未验证债务"的存量模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出Verification Kit作为标准化验证工具，为AI自主开发工作流提供可操作的验证框架，建议将验证吞吐量作为一级安全要求纳入治理。

title: Preference-Changing Information

detail.title: Preference-Changing Information
detail.abstract: This paper studies preference-changing information, namely truthful information that changes not only beliefs, but also the utility consequences of holding those beliefs. In standard information design, Blackwell refinements weakly raise a Bayesian receiver’s decision value because posterior payoffs are convex. Here, posterior beliefs also affect experienced utility through attention, monitoring, anxiety, or compliance burdens. As a result, a Blackwell-more-informative truthful disclosure can strictly lower receiver welfare. The reversal is not a failure of Bayesian inference, but a change in the welfare object. Posterior beliefs are arguments of utility, not only inputs into expected material payoffs. The relevant design object is therefore not truth versus concealment, but the granularity of truth, namely the refinement order over truthful posterior partitions. Refinements are valuable when they cross action boundaries, but harmful when they separate posteriors inside action-stable regions with convex experiential costs. Receiver-optimal disclosure is selectively granular, while strategic senders may distort this granularity by overcoarsening near decision thresholds or over-disclosing for documentation. In medical informed consent, coarse defaults with optional refinement preserve decision-relevant information while limiting unnecessary experiential harm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究偏好改变信息，即真实信息不仅改变信念，还改变持有这些信念的效用后果。与标准信息设计不同，Blackwell更精细的信息披露可能严格降低接收者福利，因为后验信念通过注意力、监控、焦虑等影响体验效用。最优披露是有选择性地精细，策略性发送者可能扭曲这种精细度。
AI.research_question: 当信息不仅改变信念，还改变持有信念的效用体验时，真实信息披露如何影响接收者福利？Blackwell更精细的信息是否总是有益的？
AI.motivation: 标准信息设计理论认为Blackwell更精细的信息总能提高接收者决策价值，但现实中许多情境（如医疗知情同意、监控、合规负担）中，信息本身会带来心理成本（焦虑、注意力消耗等），这挑战了传统理论的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏好改变信息理论；Blackwell信息精细度序；后验信念效用理论；选择性精细披露理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，构建包含体验效用的信息设计模型，比较不同精细度水平的信息披露对接收者福利的影响。
AI.findings: Blackwell更精细的真实信息披露可能严格降低接收者福利；信息精细度在跨越行动边界时有价值，但在行动稳定区域内分离后验信念且伴随凸性体验成本时有害；接收者最优披露是选择性精细的；策略性发送者可能过度粗化或过度披露。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了信息设计理论中"Blackwell更精细信息总是有益"的传统结论；提出了后验信念直接进入效用函数的新框架；区分了"真实vs隐瞒"与"信息精细度"两个不同的设计对象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗知情同意等实践提供指导：粗粒度的默认选项配合可选精细披露，既能保留决策相关信息，又能限制不必要的体验伤害。

title: Federal University of Santa Catarina Socioeconomic Center Postgraduate Program in University Administration
affiliations: Federal University of Santa Catarina (UFSC) and Federal University of Fronteira Sul

detail.title: Federal University of Santa Catarina Socioeconomic Center Postgraduate Program in University Administration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Dont aplication
declarations.ethicsApproval: Dont aplication
declarations.funderStatement: FAPESC

detail.abstract: This research examines the factors that affect the advancement of persons with disabilities into senior management positions at Brazilian federal universities. The study investigates how structural and attitudinal ableism, rooted in eugenic legacies, perpetuates the underrepresentation of this group in decision-making and power spaces, even in the presence of a robust legal framework for inclusion. The methodology is grounded in an applied research nature with a predominantly qualitative approach and descriptive character. The author employs methodological triangulation, encompassing a systematic literature review (2019–2025), documentary analysis of the Institutional Development Plans (PDIs) of 69 federal universities, and data analysis from the Personnel Statistical Panel (PEP) using a trend analysis approach supported by ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) modeling, applied as a methodological tool for identifying projective patterns. Additionally, semi-structured interviews were conducted with public servants with disabilities who currently hold or have previously held management positions. The analysis reveals a scenario of absolute institutional invisibility, as none of the documents examined address career advancement policies or upward mobility targets for this functional segment. Although the statistical projection indicates that the minimum quota of 5% of public servants with disabilities will be met by 2028, the mapping demonstrates that entry into the public service does not guarantee progression to strategic positions. The discussion highlights that access to senior management depends on individual resilience and the ability to overcome barriers that question technical competence in the face of workplace adaptation needs. The research concludes by proposing a structural framework comprising fourteen strategic action guidelines organized into thematic axes encompassing governance, people management, organizational culture, and technology. These recommendations aim to institutionalize practices designed to overcome this scenario through intentional interventions and the formulation of public and institutional policies that dismantle systemic barriers, actively promoting anti-ableism and inclusive management as foundational values for innovation and social equity

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了巴西联邦大学中残疾人晋升至高级管理职位的障碍因素，发现即使存在健全的法律框架，结构性能力主义仍导致该群体的制度性隐形。研究通过多种方法（文献综述、政策文件分析、统计建模、访谈）揭示了残疾人在公共部门入职后无法晋升至战略职位的困境，并提出了包含14项战略行动指南的框架。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响了巴西联邦大学中残疾人晋升至高级管理职位？结构性能力主义和制度性能力主义如何即使在健全的法律框架下仍然导致该群体在决策层中的代表性不足？
AI.motivation: 巴西已建立较为完善的反歧视法律框架，但残疾人仍被排除在决策和权力空间之外。学者试图揭示这种"法律保护与现实排斥"之间的悖论，探究深层结构性障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力主义（Ableism）理论——特别是结构性能力主义和制度性能力主义；优生学遗产（Eugenic legacies）；包容性管理；代表性理论。
AI.method: 应用性研究，以定性为主、描述性为辅。采用方法三角验证，包括：（1）2019-2025年系统文献综述；（2）69所联邦大学制度发展计划（PDI）的文件分析；（3）人事统计面板（PEP）数据的ARIMA趋势分析；（4）对现任或曾任管理职位的残疾公务员的半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: （1）所有69所联邦大学的制度发展计划中均未涉及残疾人职业晋升政策或向上流动目标，呈现"绝对制度性隐形"；（2）统计预测显示到2028年将达到残疾人公务员5%最低配额，但入职不等于晋升；（3）进入高级管理职位依赖于个人韧性和克服障碍的能力，且残疾人的技术能力常因工作场所适应需求而受到质疑。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了能力主义在公共部门管理情境中的理论应用，揭示了法律框架与制度实践之间的脱节机制，提出"制度性隐形"概念来解释形式包容与实质排斥的悖论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包含14项战略行动指南的结构性框架，涵盖治理、人员管理、组织文化和技术四大主题轴，为公共机构制定反能力主义和包容性管理政策提供了具体路径。

No ethics approval was required.
