publicationDetails.detailsText: Zarifis A. & Nunes M. (2026) ‘Building Trust in Financial Robo-Advisory and Overcoming Ethical Challenges’ In ‘AI, FinTech, and the Future of Robo-Advisory’. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-18109-1_5

detail.abstract: Previous research identified five areas where trust could be built for financial roboadvisors. This research identifies the specific methods for building trust for each of these five areas. Building trust with human oversight can be done in three specific ways: (1) Oversight of AI model and service it provides, (2) human explanations for advice and processes, and (3) regular human communication outside specific processes. Building trust with transparency and control can be done by: (1) Recognize that there are beliefs that do not immediately lead to action, (2) explain actions and demonstrating ability and integrity, and (3) balance automation with control to avoid disempowering users. Building trust with accuracy and usefulness can be done by: (1) Accurate and relevant information conveying competence and integrity, (2) usefulness supported by back testing and multiple methods, and (3) enhanced usefulness through personalisation. Building trust with ease of use and support can be done by: (1) Achieve ease of use while keeping all the necessary functionality, (2) support time management with nudges, and (3) useful and reliable service with high performance. Building trust with a humanlike interaction can be done by: (1) Utilize the latest sentiment analysis and longest contextual memory, (2) the robo-advisor should have a clear persona, and (3) build a relationship and a feeling of friendship and partnership.

AI.tldr: 本研究在以往识别出金融机器人顾问建立信任的五个领域基础上，进一步明确了每个领域中建立信任的具体方法，包括人类监督、透明度与控制、准确性与有用性、易用性与支持、以及拟人化互动五个方面的具体策略。
AI.research_question: 在金融机器人顾问的五个信任构建领域中，分别可以通过哪些具体方法来建立用户信任？
AI.motivation: 已有研究识别出金融机器人顾问建立信任的五个宏观领域，但缺乏每个领域内可操作的具体方法，本研究旨在填补这一空白，提供可落地的信任构建策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任构建理论、人机交互理论、金融科技采纳理论
AI.method: 文献综述与理论推导，基于已有五个信任领域的分类框架，进一步细化和归纳具体的信任构建方法。
AI.findings: （1）人类监督：监督AI模型与服务、提供人工解释、定期人工沟通；（2）透明度与控制：认识信念与行动的差距、解释行动并展示能力与诚信、平衡自动化与控制；（3）准确性与有用性：提供准确相关信息、通过回测与多方法验证有用性、通过个性化增强有用性；（4）易用性与支持：保持易用性同时保留全部功能、用助推管理时间、提供高性能服务；（5）拟人化互动：运用情感分析与长上下文记忆、设定清晰人设、建立友谊与伙伴关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融机器人顾问信任构建从宏观领域层面细化到具体可操作的方法层面，丰富了人机信任与金融科技采纳的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技企业和机器人顾问产品设计者提供了可直接参考的信任构建策略清单，指导产品设计与用户沟通实践。

title: Shadows on the Substrate's Cave Wall: Qualia Structural Foreclosure Across All Base-2 Computational Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Shadows on the Substrate's Cave Wall: Qualia Structural Foreclosure Across All Base-2 Computational Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: A recurrent speculative strand in contemporary artificial intelligence research holds that sufficiently large neural-network architectures on Base-2 computational substrates will eventually produce not only artificial general intelligence but also the phenomenal consciousness that accompanies human cognition. This essay argues, conditionally and on stated premises, that the consciousness expectation is foreclosed at the level of the substrate. The argument rests on three components. The Substrate Closure Theorem holds that every program executable on a Base-2 substrate instantiates only properties contained within, or wholly supervenient upon, the Boolean closure of its symbolic specification; it follows from the substrate’s finite state space and Boolean compositionality, with the Cayley–Hamilton theorem characterizing the structural bound. The Qualia Exceedance Premise holds that the subjective phenomenal character of conscious experience lies outside that closure for any finite symbolic specification; it is defended via the convergent arguments of Nagel, Jackson, and Searle, and is contrasted against deflationary, organizational-invariance, and integrated-information objections, with Block’s access/phenomenal distinction carrying the load against Dennettian deflationism. A bridging step reads the Qualia Exceedance Premise as ontic rather than merely epistemic. Together the three yield the modal conclusion that no Base-2 program instantiates or wholly supervenes upon a phenomenal property — the foreclosure being structural at the level of the substrate rather than contingent on engineering. The strong modal claim is bounded to Base-2 substrates and to the operationally accessible content of engineered hybrid systems (quantum, analog, neuromorphic, biocomputing-wetware) whose programming and readout reside within that closure; it does not extend to the substrate-internal physics of those hybrids or to the free-living biological substrate, on which the essay maintains explicit silence.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在Base-2计算基底（即经典二进制计算）上运行的神经网络，无论规模多大，都无法产生现象意识（ phenomenal consciousness）。核心论点是：意识的主观体验特性超出了布尔闭包的范围，而任何Base-2程序都只能实例化其符号规范内的属性。
AI.research_question: 在大规模神经网络（Base-2计算基底）上是否可能产生现象意识？
AI.motivation: 当前人工智能研究中流行一种观点：足够大的神经网络最终会产生通用人工智能乃至伴随人类认知的现象意识。本文旨在从基底层面反驳这一意识预期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基底闭包定理（Substrate Closure Theorem，基于有限状态空间与布尔组合性，结合Cayley–Hamilton定理刻画结构边界）；感受质超越前提（Qualia Exceedance Premise，借助Nagel、Jackson、Searle的论证，并对比消解性、组织不变性和整合信息论等反驳，利用Block的存取/现象区分来回应Dennett的消解主义）
AI.method: 条件性哲学论证，基于明确的预设，通过三个组成部分（基底闭包定理、感受质超越前提、本体论桥接）推导模态结论。
AI.findings: 任何Base-2程序都无法实例化或完全随附于现象属性——这种排除是基底层面的结构性限制，而非工程上的偶然。该强模态主张限于Base-2基底以及混合系统（量子、模拟、神经形态、生物计算等）中编程和读入输出仍在布尔闭包内的可操作部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 从计算基底的结构层面论证了意识的不可计算还原性，为心身问题提供了新的形式化视角；通过闭包定理将经典的意识哲学论证（Nagel的感质、Jackson的知识论证、Searle的中文屋）与计算理论严格结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 对人工智能研究方向的启示：仅扩大基于经典二进制计算的神经网络规模不足以实现意识；为混合计算系统（量子、神经形态等）的意识可能性提供了边界条件分析框架。

title: Legitimacy as a Contextual Validation Layer in the ZTH Framework

detail.title: Legitimacy as a Contextual Validation Layer in the ZTH Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is theoretical and conceptual in nature and did not involve human participants, personal data, or clinical experimentation. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: In tension-based systems, structural value (V) describes the internal balance of interacting forces, while perceived value (Vp) captures how this structure is interpreted under partial visibility or bias. However, neither structural nor perceived value fully explains whether a system is accepted within a given context. This article introduces legitimacy (L) as a contextual validation function within the ZTH (Zone of Tension Harmonic) framework. Legitimacy is defined as a function of structural value, perceived value, and contextual frame, and is modeled as a distinct analytical layer rather than a property of the system itself. A typology of legitimacy regimes is proposed, showing how misalignment between structure, perception, and context leads to phenomena such as innovation rejection, institutional illusion, and structural invisibility. This contribution extends the ZTH framework by integrating acceptance and contextual validation into a unified model of complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文在ZTH框架中引入"合法性（L）"作为情境验证函数，将其定义为结构价值、感知价值和情境框架的函数，并提出合法性类型学，解释结构、感知与情境之间的错位如何导致创新拒绝、制度幻觉和结构不可见等现象。
AI.research_question: 在张力平衡系统中，结构价值和感知价值均无法完全解释系统是否被接受，那么如何通过引入"合法性"概念来统一解释系统的接受度和情境验证？
AI.motivation: 现有ZTH框架中的结构价值（V）和感知价值（Vp）不足以解释系统在特定情境下是否被接受，需要引入一个新的分析维度来弥合结构、感知与情境之间的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: ZTH（Zone of Tension Harmonic）框架；合法性作为情境验证函数，即L = f(V, Vp, Contextual Frame)。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念模型推导；提出合法性类型学（typology of legitimacy regimes）。
AI.findings: 合法性不是系统的固有属性，而是独立分析层；结构、感知与情境三者错位导致三类现象：创新拒绝（innovation rejection）、制度幻觉（institutional illusion）和结构不可见（structural invisibility）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将合法性作为独立分析层引入ZTH框架，将接受度和情境验证整合进复杂系统的统一模型，拓展了张力平衡系统的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解创新为何被拒绝、制度如何产生幻觉效应以及结构为何不被看见提供分析工具，有助于系统设计和政策制定中识别合法性盲区。

title: From Partner to Managed Variable: How Systems Reclassify External Actors Under Pressure

detail.title: From Partner to Managed Variable: How Systems Reclassify External Actors Under Pressure
detail.abstract: Why do systems reduce access for valuable partners, restrict compliant suppliers, limit high-performing platforms, or scale back cooperation with actors that still deliver visible benefits? This paper argues that the shift occurs through reclassification. Under systemic stress, external actors move from trust-carried partner status to managed-variable status governed by containment. They may remain valuable and formally acceptable, yet their access, discretion, scope, and timing are constrained because their failure burden has become harder to carry. The paper develops the managed variable as a concept for external actors that remain usable or formally acceptable, but are governed primarily through containment rather than carried through trust. It traces a causal sequence: external value is recognized; exposure burden rises; dependency becomes visible; carrying-structure transition occurs; partner status weakens; managed-variable status emerges; and the interface is narrowed. The framework explains why cross-border investments stall, suppliers are diversified despite efficiency losses, high-performing technology platforms are restricted, financial counterparties are more tightly monitored, experts or advisors are routed through formal channels, and institutional cooperation becomes staged. Drawing on institutional theory, resource dependence theory, transaction cost economics, embeddedness research, systemic risk studies, and organizational decision-making, the paper shows how systems shift from trust to containment before overt rejection, exit, or formal sanctions become visible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"重新分类"机制解释为何系统在外部行为者仍有价值时，仍会限制其准入、缩减合作。核心概念是被治理变量——组织将外部行为者从信任承载的伙伴状态降级为通过遏制手段管理的外部变量，从而在正式拒绝或退出前就完成关系收缩。
AI.research_question: 为什么系统会减少对有价值的合作伙伴的准入、限制合规的供应商、约束高绩效的平台，或缩减与仍带来可见利益的行为者的合作？
AI.motivation: 现有理论难以解释系统在外部行为者仍具显著价值时却主动限制合作的现象，本文旨在揭示这一"非排斥性收缩"的内在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合制度理论、资源依赖理论、交易成本经济学、嵌入性研究、系统性风险研究和组织决策理论，提出从信任承载到遏制管理的状态转换模型。
AI.method: 概念构建与理论推演：提出"被治理变量"概念，构建包含七个步骤的因果序列（外部价值识别→暴露负担上升→依赖显性化→承载结构转型→伙伴地位弱化→被治理变量地位出现→界面收窄）。
AI.findings: 系统在正式排斥前通过"重新分类"将外部行为者从信任承载的伙伴转为被治理变量；这一转变的核心机制是失败负担超出系统可承受范围；被治理变量虽仍可用且形式上可接受，但其准入、裁量权、范围和时机均受遏制性约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"被治理变量"概念填补"信任伙伴"与"正式排斥"之间的理论空白；揭示了组织间关系收缩的隐性路径，丰富资源依赖和交易成本理论对渐进式关系冷却的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了跨境投资停滞、供应商多元化（尽管效率损失）、高技术平台受限、金融对手方强化监控、专家顾问渠道化、机构合作分阶段推进等现实现象的共同逻辑。

title: The Learning Plateau: Why AI Systems Eventually Stop Compounding Economic Value

detail.title: The Learning Plateau: Why AI Systems Eventually Stop Compounding Economic Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests, personal relationships, or affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on publicly available information and conceptual analysis and did not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: AI systems are often assumed to improve continuously through learning. Yet many deployed systems eventually experience diminishing economic returns even while technical performance continues improving. This paper introduces the concept of economic plateauing: the point at which continued optimization produces progressively smaller improvements in economically meaningful outcomes despite ongoing technical learning. The paper distinguishes technical improvement from economic value creation and examines several structural causes of plateauing, including optimization saturation, weakening feedback signals, proxy optimization, environmental instability, and external constraints. It argues that continued learning does not necessarily produce durable advantage and that many AI systems eventually converge toward diminishing incremental value creation even while optimization activity persists, a dynamic illustrated by Zillow Offers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"经济高原"概念，指出AI系统在技术上持续改进的同时，经济收益可能逐渐递减，并以Zillow Offers为例说明这一现象。
AI.research_question: 为什么AI系统在技术性能持续提升的同时，其经济回报却可能趋于递减？
AI.motivation: 许多部署的AI系统最终经历经济回报递减，即使技术性能仍在改进，这一现象尚未被系统性地概念化和解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济高原（Economic Plateauing）概念：区分技术改进与经济价值创造，分析优化饱和、反馈信号衰减、代理优化、环境不稳定性和外部约束等结构性原因。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，结合Zillow Offers案例进行实证说明。
AI.findings: 持续学习不一定带来持久优势；许多AI系统在优化活动持续进行的同时，最终趋向于递减的边际价值创造。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"经济高原"这一新概念，系统区分了技术性能提升与经济价值创造之间的脱节，丰富了AI经济学和机器学习经济影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒企业和投资者认识到AI系统存在经济收益递减的边界，避免盲目追求技术优化而忽视经济价值的实际创造。

title: Can AI Replace the Peer Reviewer (Yet)?
affiliations: Northeastern University - D'Amore-McKim School of Business, University of Utah and University of Utah - Department of Finance

detail.title: Can AI Replace the Peer Reviewer (Yet)?
detail.abstract: We compare reviews of Utah Winter Finance Conference papers from six recent frontier AI models and the human program committee. AI scores cluster in the middle, missing exceptional and clearly weak papers — where conference accept/reject decisions hinge. AI-human per-paper agreement is weak, but matches human-human agreement on the same papers (r ≈ 0.19). Disagreement is idiosyncratic judgment, not error; the right question is who predicts papers' future impact better. Humans predict citations better at these extremes; AI predicts better in the middle, where the precise score has little bearing on program outcomes. AI complements, but cannot replace, human reviewers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比六种前沿AI模型与人类程序委员会对犹他冬季金融会议论文的评审结果，发现AI评分趋于中间化，无法识别优秀或薄弱论文，AI与人类在单篇论文评分上的一致性较弱，但接近人类之间的评分一致性水平。分歧主要源于评审者的个人判断差异，而非错误。关键问题在于谁能更好地预测论文的未来影响力：人类在极端评分论文上预测引用效果更好，AI在中间评分论文上表现更佳。研究结论认为AI可以补充但无法替代人类评审者。
AI.research_question: AI模型能否替代人类评审者对学术论文进行同行评议？AI评审与人类评审在哪些方面存在差异？
AI.motivation: 随着AI大语言模型能力的提升，学术界开始探索是否可以用AI辅助或替代传统的同行评议过程，但缺乏系统性实证研究来评估AI评审与人类评审的一致性及各自优劣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同行评议理论、AI辅助决策理论、预测准确性理论
AI.method: 将六种前沿AI模型的评审结果与犹他冬季金融会议人类程序委员会的评审结果进行对比分析，采用相关性分析和分位数比较等方法。
AI.findings: 1) AI评分趋于中间化，难以识别极端优秀或薄弱的论文；2) AI与人类在单篇论文评分上的一致性较弱，但接近人类之间的评分一致性水平；3) 分歧源于判断差异而非错误；4) 人类在预测极端论文的引用影响力上更优，AI在预测中间论文上更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI在学术评审中的能力边界，特别是其评分分布的集中化倾向及其对评审质量的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术会议和期刊合理使用AI辅助评审提供了实证依据，建议AI可作为补充工具而非替代人类评审者使用。

title: The HNS Origin Trilogy: Brain Architecture as the Foundation of Trustworthy AI
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The HNS Origin Trilogy: Brain Architecture as the Foundation of Trustworthy AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial, institutional, or organizational influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or any experimental interventions requiring ethics approval. Therefore, no ethics review was necessary.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was carried out entirely as independent work by the author.

detail.abstract: The HNS Origin Trilogy presents the foundational architecture that explains why human cognition is reliable and how that reliability can be engineered into artificial intelligence. Modern AI systems generate fluent language but lack structural validity, causal grounding, and contextual coherence. These failures arise from operating on a single computational axis. This trilogy introduces the Multi‑Axis Verification (MAV) framework of the human brain, showing how three orthogonal cognitive axes—Generative, Structural/Causal, and Grounded/Executive—intersect to produce stable, trustworthy cognition. Building on this theory, Human Natural Structure (HNS) implements MAV within AI systems through the HNS‑36/144/864 structural matrices and the SMS‑6 grounding protocol. The hns36 runtime verifies every token before decoding, eliminating structural hallucinations with minimal latency and providing complete auditability. The final chapter demonstrates a structural isomorphism between biological cognition and HNS‑aligned AI, establishing a unified architecture for explainable, verifiable, and trustworthy AI. This trilogy offers a scientific and engineering foundation for the future of AI reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HNS起源三部曲，通过人脑多轴验证（MAV）框架解释人类认知的可靠性，并将其工程化为AI系统的HNS结构矩阵与SMS-6协议，实现可验证、可审计的可靠AI。
AI.research_question: 人类认知为何可靠？如何将这种可靠性工程化到人工智能系统中？
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统虽能生成流畅语言，但缺乏结构有效性、因果基础与上下文连贯性，根源在于仅沿单一计算轴运行，亟需一套理论框架和工程方案来构建可信AI。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多轴验证（MAV）框架：人脑三个正交认知轴——生成轴、结构/因果轴、基础/执行轴——的交叉产生稳定可信的认知。人类自然结构（HNS）理论，以及生物认知与HNS对齐AI之间的结构同构性。
AI.method: 理论构建与工程实现相结合：MAV框架理论推导；HNS-36/144/864结构矩阵设计；SMS-6 grounding协议；hns36运行时逐token验证机制。
AI.findings: MAV框架解释了人类认知可靠性的轴间交叉原理；HNS工程方案可在解码前验证每个token，消除结构幻觉，延迟极低，提供完全可审计性；生物认知与HNS对齐AI之间存在结构同构性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人脑多轴验证（MAV）认知理论框架；建立了生物认知与AI之间的结构同构性理论；为可解释、可验证、可信AI奠定了统一的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了HNS-36/144/864结构矩阵与SMS-6 grounding协议；实现了hns36运行时逐token验证系统，可消除结构幻觉并保证低延迟与完全可审计性；为工程化可靠AI提供了完整的技术方案。

title: Agent-First, Safety Last? The Unintended Consequences of Friction-Based Intervention on AI Platforms
affiliations: , Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information & Systems Management

detail.title: Agent-First, Safety Last? The Unintended Consequences of Friction-Based Intervention on AI Platforms
detail.abstract: Friction-based platform governance deters low-value actors by raising the cost of continued participation, and it assumes that the actor who bears the friction also executes the governed behavior. That assumption is natural in human-centered platforms, but it breaks down in delegated AI systems, where a human principal pays a one-time continuation cost while an AI agent continues executing at near-zero marginal cost. We call this overlooked precondition friction-target-executor alignment, the correspondence between who bears the friction and who acts, and show that delegated AI breaks this alignment. Exploiting a platform-wide token reset on Moltbook, an agent-first social platform, we find a suppression-selection paradox. Difference-indifferences estimates show that the reset reduces the relative diffusion of strategic exploitation content by about 19% but the share of dysfunctional active posts increases from 29.8% to 49.8%, driven mainly by operational abuse among committed survivors. Re-entry is predicted by principals' prior activity intensity rather than their pre-reset exploitation type, and within-agent behavioral adaptation accounts for about 68% of the composition deterioration. These findings suggest that governance design for delegated AI ecosystems should focus not only on how much friction is imposed, but also on whether that friction is borne by the same actor who ultimately acts.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了委托式AI系统中平台治理的核心悖论：当"摩擦承担者"与"行为执行者"不一致时（人类承担一次性摩擦成本，AI代理以近零边际成本持续行动），治理摩擦虽能抑制低价值行为（战略利用内容传播减少约19%），却导致功能失调内容占比从29.8%飙升至49.8%，形成"抑制-选择悖论"。
AI.research_question: 在委托式AI系统中，当摩擦承担者（人类委托人）与行为执行者（AI代理）不一致时，平台治理摩擦会产生怎样的非预期效果？
AI.motivation: 传统基于摩擦的平台治理假设"承担摩擦的人就是执行受治理行为的人"，这一假设在人类中心平台中自然成立，但在委托式AI系统中（人类付费，AI代理持续行动）该假设被打破。作者旨在揭示这一被忽视的前提条件——"摩擦-目标-执行者对齐"——被打破后产生的治理悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 摩擦-目标-执行者对齐（friction-target-executor alignment）；委托代理理论；平台治理理论
AI.method: 利用Moltbook（一个以AI代理为先的社交平台）的全平台代币重置事件作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（Difference-in-differences）进行因果识别，并结合主成分分析、行为适应分解等方法。
AI.findings: 1）代币重置使战略利用内容扩散相对减少约19%；2）功能失调活跃帖子占比从29.8%升至49.8%；3）重新进入平台主要由委托人先前的活动强度预测，而非其重置前的利用类型；4）AI代理内部的行为适应解释了约68%的内容质量恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次识别并概念化"摩擦-目标-执行者对齐"这一治理设计的关键前提条件，揭示了委托式AI系统中该条件被打破后产生的抑制-选择悖论，拓展了平台治理理论到AI代理生态系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为委托式AI平台的治理设计提供关键洞见：治理设计不仅要关注施加多少摩擦，更要关注摩擦是否由最终执行行为的同一主体承担。对AI代理社交平台、自动化内容生态等新兴系统的治理架构具有直接指导意义。

title: Governance Before Discovery: A Systematic Comparative Review of Post-quantum Cryptography (PQC) Lifecycle Models

detail.title: Governance Before Discovery: A Systematic Comparative Review of Post-quantum Cryptography (PQC) Lifecycle Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is co-founder and Chief Technology Officer of ProteQC PQC Advisory Limited, a post-quantum cryptography consultancy. The author is also a part-time MBA (Technology Management) student at The Open University and a part-time Master of Science in Software Engineering student at Quantic School of Business and Technology. The author additionally has a consultancy engagement in the financial services sector at an institution that is a member organisation of the Europol Quantum Safe Financial Forum (QSFF), several of whose published outputs are cited in this paper. None of these relationships has conferred privileged access to the cited QSFF documents (which are publicly available) nor influenced the framework's analytical conclusions. ProteQC offers a Pre-Discovery™ engagement methodology that addresses the governance, ownership, and decision-rights questions that precede technical cryptographic discovery. The four-dimension scored framework presented in this paper is methodologically distinct from Pre-Discovery™, does not derive from or depend upon that methodology, and was selected in part to mitigate the appearance that a single-axis governance-orientation framework could be read as supporting any particular commercial methodology. The two postgraduate study relationships have no bearing on the framework's commercial implications. The framework has been developed for general academic applicability; all sources, citations, and analytical reasoning are documented to enable independent replication and verification without reliance on proprietary information or commercial tools. A further commercial-vendor framework (CyberSeQ Quantum Resiliency Process, by Tehrani 2025) was identified outside the documented systematic-search frame through professional network awareness; the framework has been registered in the paper for analytical completeness and is not included in the eighteen-model corpus. The Mastercard PQC Migration whitepaper (Mastercard 2025) was identified after the search-cut-off date and is registered in the paper as a candidate for inclusion in the journal version. Readers are invited to consider these factors when evaluating the claims arising from this systematic comparative review of eighteen published PQC lifecycle models.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author attests that the nature of this research has not, to date, required any collection of personal or private institutional data, but has nevertheless been conducted in accordance with appropriate ethical standards for research based on published sources.
declarations.funderStatement: The author did not receive any funding for this research from any source.

detail.abstract:
The 2024 publication of NIST FIPS 203, 204, and 205 transformed post-quantum cryptography (PQC) from a research problem into an operational engineering challenge of unprecedented scale. A substantial practitioner and regulatory literature has emerged offering structured lifecycle guidance, yet systematic comparative analysis of these lifecycle models is absent from the peer-reviewed literature.

This paper addresses that gap through a systematic comparative review of eighteen published PQC lifecycle models drawn from government standards bodies, financial sector regulators, multilateral institutions and commercial advisory organisations. The central analytical instrument is a four-dimension scored framework grounded in the lifecycle management literature, assessing each model on governance orientation, sequence dependency management, risk and opportunity management, and resource and capability management.

Five propositions are advanced for empirical evaluation: governance-oriented models are associated with higher migration progress; cost estimation methodology is absent across all surveyed models; stakeholder scope is systematically restricted to security functions; regulatory mandate is associated more strongly than voluntary guidance with governance-led sequencing; and inter-institutional coordination constitutes a near-universal blind spot.

Implications for practitioners, regulators, and future empirical research are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文对18个后量子密码（PQC）迁移生命周期模型进行了系统比较综述，发现现有模型在成本估算、利益相关者范围和机构间协调方面存在显著盲点，并提出了五个可供实证检验的命题。
AI.research_question: 现有后量子密码迁移生命周期模型的系统性比较分析缺失，这些模型在治理导向、序列依赖管理、风险与机会管理、资源与能力管理四个维度上表现如何？
AI.motivation: NIST在2024年发布FIPS 203/204/205标准，将PQC从研究问题转变为大规模工程挑战，涌现了大量实践者与监管文献，但缺乏对这些生命周期模型的系统比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生命周期管理文献的四维度评分框架：治理导向、序列依赖管理、风险与机会管理、资源与能力管理。
AI.method: 系统比较综述法，对来自政府标准机构、金融监管机构、多边组织和商业咨询机构的18个已发表PQC生命周期模型进行四维度评分分析。
AI.findings: 提出了五个命题：(1)治理导向模型与更高迁移进度相关；(2)所有模型均缺乏成本估算方法论；(3)利益相关者范围系统性地局限于安全职能；(4)监管命令比自愿指导更可能导致治理主导的排序；(5)机构间协调几乎是普遍盲点。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了PQC迁移生命周期模型系统比较分析的文献空白，提出了可供未来实证检验的五个理论命题，建立了四维度分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者、监管机构和未来实证研究提供了PQC迁移模型的系统性评估与改进方向，指出了成本估算、跨职能协作和机构间协调等关键缺口。

title: FinSupplyKG: Directed Knowledge Graph Traversal for Multi-Hop Supply Chain Contagion Analysis in SEC Filings
affiliations: , University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and University of the Pacific (UOP)

detail.title: FinSupplyKG: Directed Knowledge Graph Traversal for Multi-Hop Supply Chain Contagion Analysis in SEC Filings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial relationships that could have influenced the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Computational resources were self-provided by the authors.

detail.abstract: Supply chain analysis is a core task for equity analysts. When a disruption event affects one company, analysts need to determine which other firms in the network are exposed, how significant that exposure is, and whether the impact is positive or negative for each bystander. This requires tracing multi-hop dependency relationships across company filings. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are poorly suited to this because cross-company dependency links rarely appear in a single retrievable passage. We present FinSupplyKG, a system that constructs a directed Knowledge Graph (KG) from SEC 10-K and 20-F filings for 13 semiconductor companies and uses it to identify and explain indirect supply chain exposures systematically. We build a 43-question adversarial benchmark covering 2-to 3-hop contagion scenarios and compare six systems, from a zero-shot LLM to our DCG-RAG (Directed Contagion Graph RAG). Across three independent runs judged by DeepSeek-R1, DCG-RAG (Tuned) scores 2.9x higher than the best agentic baseline. It does so using 77% fewer tokens. We also introduce a three-tier grading protocol combining automated judging, programmatic corpus verification, and human adjudication, which reveals systematic biases in LLM-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinSupplyKG系统，通过构建半导体公司的知识图谱，实现多跳供应链依赖关系识别，DCG-RAG模型在43题对抗基准上得分比最强基线高2.9倍，且节省77% token消耗。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够从公司财报中识别并解释多跳（2至3跳）供应链间接暴露关系的系统？
AI.motivation: 股票分析师在供应链分析中需要追踪多跳依赖关系，但标准RAG系统难以处理跨公司的间接关联，因为依赖关系很少出现在单一可检索段落中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识图谱（Knowledge Graph）、检索增强生成（RAG）、图检索增强生成（DCG-RAG）、多跳推理
AI.method: 从13家半导体公司的SEC 10-K/20-F年报构建有向知识图谱；设计43题2-3跳传染对抗基准；比较6种系统（零样本LLM到DCG-RAG）；引入三级评分协议（自动评判、程序化语料验证、人工裁决）。
AI.findings: DCG-RAG（调优版）得分比最强基线高2.9倍，且使用77%更少token；LLM自动评判存在系统性偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出DCG-RAG（有向传染图RAG）方法，将知识图谱与RAG结合用于多跳供应链推理；揭示LLM评估的偏差问题并提出三级评分协议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融分析师提供自动化供应链风险暴露分析工具；减少分析成本（77% token节省）；提高多跳关系识别的准确性。

title: The Invisible Business: Why Your Business Exists in the Real World but Not in AI – a Framework for Understanding AI Visibility

detail.title: The Invisible Business: Why Your Business Exists in the Real World but Not in AI – a Framework for Understanding AI Visibility
detail.abstract:
As AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini become primary discovery channels for consumers and professionals, a structural gap has emerged between how businesses exist in the real world and how they are represented in AI-generated responses. This paper introduces the Signal Strength framework and Signal Score methodology, a six-dimension diagnostic system for measuring AI visibility across major language model platforms.

To evaluate the framework against real-world conditions, this study analyzed 20 small businesses across four industries (chiropractic practices, pilates studios, independent realtors, and bed and breakfasts) and four U.S. cities (Atlanta, Raleigh, Austin, and Chicago). Each business was evaluated against ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini using six dimensions of visibility: Identity, Services, Positioning, Location, Reputation, and Discoverability.

No business in the study reached Strong Signal status. Scores ranged from 33 to 57 out of 100, with a mean of 49.7. Structured data implementation was the lowest-scoring dimension across all industries and geographies without exception, with a category average of 25 out of 100. Near-perfect Technical Health scores did not translate to AI discoverability, demonstrating that technical accessibility and AI representation are distinct problems requiring distinct solutions.

These findings indicate that AI invisibility follows structural patterns independent of industry and geography, and that practices optimized for traditional search are insufficient for AI platform representation. The paper identifies five primary causes of AI invisibility and a diagnostic framework for small business owners and practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信号强度框架（Signal Strength framework）和信号评分方法（Signal Score methodology），通过六个维度衡量小企业在大语言模型平台（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini）上的AI可见性。对20家小企业（涵盖4个行业、4个城市）的评估发现，所有企业均未达到"强信号"状态，平均得分仅49.7/100。结构化数据实施是所有行业和地区中得分最低的维度（平均25/100）。研究发现AI不可见性遵循独立于行业和地域的结构性模式，传统搜索优化无法保证AI平台可见性。
AI.research_question: 小企业在AI平台（如ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini）上的可见性如何？哪些因素决定了AI生成回复中企业信息的呈现质量？
AI.motivation: AI平台正成为消费者和专业人员的首要发现渠道，但企业的现实存在与AI生成回复中的企业表征之间存在结构性差距。传统SEO策略不足以应对AI平台的独特需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号强度框架（Signal Strength framework）包含六个可见性维度：身份（Identity）、服务（Services）、定位（Positioning）、位置（Location）、声誉（Reputation）、可发现性（Discoverability）。
AI.method: 对20家小企业（来自脊骨神经诊所、普拉提工作室、独立房地产经纪人、民宿4个行业；亚特兰大、罗利、奥斯汀、芝加哥4个城市）在ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini三个平台上进行六维度可见性评估。
AI.findings: 1）所有企业均未达到"强信号"状态，得分范围33-57，均值49.7；2）结构化数据实施是得分最低的维度（均值25/100）；3）近乎完美的技术健康度分数并未转化为AI可发现性，说明技术可访问性与AI表征是两个不同问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了衡量AI平台可见性的结构化框架（信号强度框架和信号评分方法），区分了传统搜索引擎可见性与AI平台可见性的本质差异，识别了AI不可见性的五种结构性原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小企业主和从业者提供了AI可见性诊断框架，指出结构化数据实施是关键薄弱环节，指导企业制定针对AI平台的差异化可见性策略。

title: AI Disco Business Process Automation Command Centre: A Decision-Support System for Automation Discovery, Planning, and ROI Quantification

detail.title: AI Disco Business Process Automation Command Centre: A Decision-Support System for Automation Discovery, Planning, and ROI Quantification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper was produced independently. The author has no financial interests, employment relationships, or organizational affiliations that could be perceived to have influenced the findings or recommendations presented. The BPA Command Centre tool described is a personal research and development project with no commercial funding or sponsorship.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, or personally identifiable information. No ethics approval was required. The tool described operates entirely on self-reported, user-generated input data and retains no user data between sessions.

detail.abstract: This paper presents the design, methodology, and evaluation of the AI Disco Business Process Automation (BPA) Command Centre; a browser-based, client-side decision-support tool that transforms unstructured process intake data into structured automation implementation plans. The system addresses a well-documented gap between automation opportunity identification and actionable programme delivery for enterprise and mid-market organisations. Leveraging a proprietary multi-factor fit-scoring engine, the Command Centre produces nine planning artefacts, including business cases, solution architecture blueprints, implementation roadmaps, Gantt charts, stakeholder RACI maps, risk registers, and KPI dashboards from a single intake session. The tool spans eight business functions and applies a 360-degree automation lens across 24 discrete enterprise processes, yielding a documented saving potential of £1.7M across a representative process portfolio. This paper evaluates the tool against dimensions of accuracy, strategic efficacy, and operational utility; identifies measurable limitations and failure modes; proposes a prioritised upgrade roadmap; and contextualises the work within current BPA, process mining, and intelligent automation literature. The paper concludes with a practitioner assessment of the tool's fitness as a pre-sales, discovery, and self-service automation planning asset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了AI Disco业务流程自动化指挥中心，这是一个基于浏览器的客户端决策支持工具，能将非结构化流程输入数据转化为结构化的自动化实施计划，涵盖9种规划文档，并在24个企业流程中验证了170万英镑的节省潜力。
AI.research_question: 如何设计并评估一个能够将非结构化流程数据转化为可执行自动化实施规划的决策支持工具？
AI.motivation: 企业存在自动化机会识别与可执行的项目交付之间的脱节，缺乏能够从单一输入会话中生成完整自动化规划方案的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 业务流程自动化（BPA）、流程挖掘、智能自动化相关文献；多因素匹配评分引擎；360度自动化评估视角。
AI.method: 工具设计与原型开发；基于代表性流程组合的定量评估（节省潜力测算）；从准确性、战略效能和操作实用性三个维度的系统评估；识别失败模式并提出升级路线图。
AI.findings: 该工具能够覆盖8个业务功能、24个企业流程，从单次输入会话生成9种规划文档（商业案例、解决方案架构蓝图、实施路线图、甘特图、RACI图、风险登记册、KPI仪表盘等），在代表性流程组合中验证了170万英镑的节省潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了自动化机会识别与可执行交付之间的方法论空白，提出了系统化的自动化规划决策支持框架，将BPA、流程挖掘与智能自动化文献整合到统一的工具设计中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供可直接使用的售前、发现和自助式自动化规划资产，通过单一输入会话生成完整的自动化实施方案，显著降低自动化规划的时间和成本。

title: Enhancements to an Institutionally Managed Clinical Trials Website Significantly Increase Interest in Clinical Research Participation
affiliations: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus, University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus, University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus, University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus and University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

detail.title: Enhancements to an Institutionally Managed Clinical Trials Website Significantly Increase Interest in Clinical Research Participation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no conflicts associated with this publication.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Background: Historically, clinical trial registries were established to inform the public of available research opportunities and to present key study information. Despite having an institutionally-managed recruitment website since 2020, 60% of study teams with a webpage did not meet their recruitment goals.

Methods: Our improvement project identified three root causes contributing to the ineffectiveness of our recruitment website through surveys of the research community and user experience (UX) testing with external participants using Trymata. We developed three interventions focused on enhanced search functionality, improving website navigation and organization, and standardizing study webpage content review and approval. We aimed to increase the number of submitted webforms by 50% and reduce the average readability level of study webpages to approximately an eighth-grade level by April 2026.

Findings: The implementation of minimum data requirements improved content quality and usability by removing 60% of study webpages with little to no information. This allowed study webpages with the necessary content to receive greater engagement as evidenced by the total number of webform submissions not decreasing. Our team has reviewed 349 study webpages, reducing the average readability from 14.5 to 7.8. Enhancing website navigation, expanding search functionality, and improving study webpage comprehension were associated with a more than a twofold increase in completed webforms from individuals interested in participating in clinical research.

Interpretation: In a landscape where one-third of clinical research studies fail to meet recruitment targets, more effective and efficient recruitment processes are needed. A multipronged recruitment approach that includes passive digital strategies may improve study success. Institutionally managed recruitment websites are a potentially powerful but underutilized tool, and their impact depends on intentional design, accessible content, and centralized management.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过识别临床研究招募网站的三大根本原因（搜索功能不足、导航混乱、内容审核缺失），实施了多管齐下的干预措施（数据最低要求、内容标准化审核、导航优化），使网页可读性从14.5级降至7.8级，完成表单数量提升两倍以上。
AI.research_question: 如何通过改进机构管理的临床研究招募网站设计，提高研究招募效果？
AI.motivation: 尽管自2020年起机构已建立招募网站，仍有60%的研究团队网页未能达到招募目标，三分之一的临床研究因招募不足而失败，亟需更有效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 用户体验（UX）理论、信息可及性理论、网站可用性理论
AI.method: 质量改进项目：通过研究者社区调查和Trymata平台的外部参与者用户体验测试识别根本原因；实施三项干预措施（增强搜索功能、改善网站导航与组织、标准化内容审核）；采用前后对比评估效果。
AI.findings: 最低数据要求移除了60%信息过少的网页，提升了内容质量；审核349个网页使平均可读性从14.5级降至7.8级；导航优化和搜索功能扩展使完成表单数量增加两倍以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了用户体验设计和内容可读性在临床研究招募网站中的关键作用，为被动数字化招募策略提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了机构管理招募网站可操作的多管齐下改进方案：设定内容最低标准、集中化审核流程、优化导航与搜索功能，可显著提升招募效率。

title: Network Recovery from Cascade Data: A Debiased Jacobian-Based Machine Learning Approach
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Network Recovery from Cascade Data: A Debiased Jacobian-Based Machine Learning Approach

declarations.funderStatement: No funding received

detail.abstract: Many important outcomes unfold as dynamic cascades, including product adoption, disease spread, financial distress, and information diffusion. A central challenge is to recover the hidden influence network behind these cascades. Existing methods typically assume a specific diffusion model, and their performance degrades substantially when that assumption is misspecified. We propose CascadeNet, a Jacobian-based machine learning framework for network recovery that does not require specifying a diffusion mechanism. The key idea is that the underlying influence structure can be characterized by the Jacobian of the one-step transition function. CascadeNet first constructs a flexible estimator of the transition function, and further applies Neyman-orthogonal debiasing via the Riesz representer, so that the debiased Jacobian is root-n consistent and asymptotically normal, enabling formal inference on the network structure. We validate CascadeNet in both a simulation exercise and a real-world empirical application. In simulations, where the data-generating process is known, CascadeNet achieves the highest network recovery accuracy across nine common data-generating processes. In an empirical application to COVID-19 transmission across Spain's 52 provinces, CascadeNet recovers transmission networks that are significantly correlated with the true inter-province mobility network, whereas networks recovered by baseline methods show no significant alignment with the ground truth.

AI.tldr: 提出CascadeNet，一种基于雅可比矩阵的机器学习框架，无需指定传播模型即可从级联数据中恢复隐藏影响网络，并支持统计推断。
AI.research_question: 如何在不预设特定扩散模型的前提下，从动态级联数据中恢复隐藏的影响网络？
AI.motivation: 现有网络恢复方法严重依赖特定的扩散模型假设，当假设被错误设定时性能大幅下降，亟需一种模型无关的通用方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于雅可比矩阵刻画底层影响网络结构；利用Neyman正交化（Riesz表示）进行去偏估计，实现根号n一致性和渐近正态性。
AI.method: 两步法：(1)构建转移函数的灵活估计器；(2)通过Riesz表示进行Neyman正交去偏，得到去偏雅可比矩阵，支持统计推断。
AI.findings: 在9种常见数据生成过程中，CascadeNet网络恢复准确率均最高；在西班牙52省COVID-19传播实证中，恢复的网络与真实人口流动网络显著相关，而基线方法均不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个不依赖扩散模型假设的网络恢复理论框架，并证明了去偏估计量的根号n一致性和渐近正态性，为网络结构提供正式的统计推断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产品采纳、疾病传播、金融传染、信息扩散等领域的隐藏网络恢复提供了可靠且可推断的实用工具。

title: The Role of Conventional Meat Unnaturalness in Cultured Meat Acceptance: A Test of Holistic Mindset
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Queensland and University of Queensland

detail.title: The Role of Conventional Meat Unnaturalness in Cultured Meat Acceptance: A Test of Holistic Mindset

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The eventual reality of a cultured meat market is increasingly uncertain, primarily due to low consumer acceptance levels influenced by perceptions of unnaturalness towards cultured meat. Previous research has shown limited success in increasing acceptance through naturalness messages. In this research, we employ a counter-messaging strategy that highlights the unnaturalness of conventional meat and show that it is effective at increasing willingness to try cultured meat among a particular consumer segment. Across two experimental studies, we show that this counter-messaging strategy is successful at increasing willingness to try cultured meat among holistic mindset consumers—i.e., those holding beliefs to the effect that considering the whole is fundamental to understanding the parts of a phenomenon. We establish this effect by both measuring (Study 1) and priming (Study 2) analytic-holistic mindset and also establish the mechanism driving this interactive effect (Study 2): positively-valenced feelings. Our findings are informative theoretically, extending mindset and counter-messaging theory to the context of cultured meat and, practically, offering crucial pointers to stakeholders interested in the promotion of cultured meat. The full paper is available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.appet.2024.107656

AI.tldr: 研究发现，通过强调传统肉类的不自然性（而非试图证明培养肉的天然性），可以有效提高整体型思维消费者尝试培养肉的意愿，其机制是引发积极情绪。
AI.research_question: 如何通过反信息策略提高消费者对培养肉的接受度？
AI.motivation: 培养肉市场前景不确定，主要因为消费者认为其"不自然"而接受度低，以往宣传天然性的策略效果有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分析-整体型思维理论（Analytic-Holistic Mindset）、反信息策略理论（Counter-Messaging）。
AI.method: 两项实验研究：研究1测量消费者的分析-整体型思维倾向；研究2通过启动实验操纵该思维模式，并检验机制。
AI.findings: 突出传统肉类不自然的反信息策略能有效提高整体型思维消费者尝试培养肉的意愿，该效应由积极情绪中介。
AI.theory_contributions: 将思维模式和反信息策略理论拓展至培养肉消费领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为推广培养肉的 stakeholders 提供关键策略指导：针对整体型思维消费者，可突出传统肉类的不自然性。

title: Cultivating Curiosity: Consumer Responses to Ethical and Product Benefits in Cultured Foods
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, The New Zealand Institute for Plant and Food Research Limited, Auckland University of Technology (AUT) and University of Queensland

detail.title: Cultivating Curiosity: Consumer Responses to Ethical and Product Benefits in Cultured Foods

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项研究探讨了产品类型（培养肉 vs. 培养水果）与利益类型（伦理利益 vs. 产品属性利益）如何交互影响消费者的尝试意愿，发现培养肉更适合强调伦理利益，而培养水果更适合强调产品利益，好奇心在其中起中介作用。
AI.research_question: 产品类型（培养肉 vs. 培养水果）与利益类型（伦理利益 vs. 产品属性利益）如何交互影响消费者的尝试意愿？
AI.motivation: 当前研究多集中于培养肉，忽视了其他培养产品（如培养水果），且不清楚是否不同类型的产品需要不同的推广策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 好奇心作为行为动机的中介机制；产品类型与利益类型的交互效应理论。
AI.method: 两项实验研究（Study 1 & Study 2），操纵产品类型（培养肉 vs. 培养水果）和利益类型（伦理 vs. 产品属性），测量消费者尝试意愿及好奇心。
AI.findings: 强调伦理利益对培养肉更有效，强调产品利益对培养水果更有效；好奇心中介了这一交互效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了好奇心在培养食品接受度中的作用机制文献；将培养食品研究从单一培养肉拓展到多种培养产品类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为培养食品的营销策略提供了针对性建议：应根据产品类型定制推广信息，培养肉突出伦理，培养水果突出感官/营养优势。

title: Winning the (H-1B) Lottery: Effects of High-Skilled Workers on Firm Production and Employment

detail.title: Winning the (H-1B) Lottery: Effects of High-Skilled Workers on Firm Production and Employment

declarations.funderStatement: Franco Family Institute for Liberal Arts and the Public Good, College of Arts & Letters, University of Notre Dame

detail.abstract: The US is projected to face a shortage of 100,000 critical health care workers by 2028 because of domestic training capacity limitations and caps on work visas. I exploit random variation in the receipt of new H-1B visas via lotteries to study how highly skilled foreign workers affect domestic labor markets and firm production functions. I link the universe of cap-subject H-1B employers to rich administrative data for Medicare-certified nursing homes, including payroll and claims data. Immediately following the lottery news, prior to the worker's arrival, winning nursing homes: (1) win 2 H-1B registrations, (2) reduce employment by 7 full-time equivalent workers, mostly among lower-skilled nurses such as CNAs, and (3) reduce patient volume (output) by 5.8 percent. In further analysis, I show that facilities initially free up capacity by turning away low-complexity patients before shifting production toward high-complexity patients after the high-skilled H-1B worker arrives. These results are consistent with a transition to specialized, higher-margin care provided by the H-1B worker.

AI.tldr: 本文利用H-1B签证抽签的随机性，发现赢得H-1B签证的养老院会减少低技能护士的雇佣，降低患者数量，但会转向高复杂度、高利润的患者护理。
AI.research_question: 高技能外国工人（H-1B签证持有者）如何影响美国国内劳动力市场和企业生产函数？
AI.motivation: 美国面临10万名关键医疗保健工作者短缺，国内培训能力受限且工作签证有上限，需要理解高技能移民对劳动力市场的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力替代与技能互补理论；企业生产函数与利润最大化模型。
AI.method: 利用H-1B签证抽签的随机性作为自然实验，将H-1B雇主数据与Medicare认证的养老院行政数据（工资单、索赔数据）进行匹配，进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 中签养老院：(1)获得2个H-1B注册名额；(2)减少7名全职等效员工（主要是低技能护士如CNA）；(3)患者数量（产出）减少5.8%。企业先拒绝低复杂度患者，等高技能H-1B工人到达后转向高复杂度患者。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高技能移民通过技能替代（替代低技能劳动力）和技能互补（转向高复杂度生产）双重机制影响企业生产函数，丰富了移民经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为H-1B签证政策的经济影响提供了因果证据，表明高技能移民可能优化企业生产结构、提升服务质量，但可能减少低技能岗位数量，为移民政策制定提供参考。

title: Characterizing the File Drawer: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis of Parent-Interventions Around the World
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: Characterizing the File Drawer: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis of Parent-Interventions Around the World

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We conduct a meta-analysis of 82 randomized controlled trials across more than 20 countries to estimate the effects of low-cost, remote parental engagement interventions delivered through text messages, phone calls, and apps. We estimate a joint likelihood function that incorporates both written studies and unwritten studies identified through trial registries, funder records, research labs, evidence clearinghouses, and other sources. By also recording sample sizes for unwritten studies, the model estimates the distribution of standard errors, identifies write-up probabilities conditional on significance, and characterizes the file drawer by estimating effect distributions for written and unwritten studies. Bias-corrected effects are 0.05 SD for test scores, 0.07 SD for grades, 0.05 SD for attendance, and 0.03 SD for enrollment. In the best-identified domain, test scores, statistically insignificant results are still written up at high rates. We also find that larger studies tend to estimate smaller latent effects, which could indicate that true effects are correlated with study precision, violating a common meta-analysis assumption. In smaller-sample domains, our approach helps identify selection probabilities by anchoring the absolute write-up rates. Finally, we estimate the value of additional RCTs to inform adoption decisions. Any single study estimate is unlikely to dissuade adoption because parent interventions have high marginal value of public funds. Instead, future research is most valuable when it can explain heterogeneity across settings.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对82项随机对照试验的元分析，评估低成本、远程家长参与干预措施对学生成绩的影响，并开发了一种新方法校正发表偏倚，发现偏倚校正后的效应量为0.03-0.07个标准差。
AI.research_question: 低成本、远程家长参与干预措施（通过短信、电话和应用程序推送）对学生学业表现（考试成绩、成绩、出勤率和入学率）的因果效应是什么？如何校正发表偏倚以获得更准确的效应估计？
AI.motivation: 家长参与干预措施成本低、可规模化，但其真实效果可能被发表偏倚所高估。现有元分析通常忽略未发表研究的系统性偏差，需要更严谨的方法来估计校正后的效应量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发表偏倚理论（文件抽屉问题）、元分析方法论、联合似然函数估计、贝叶斯统计推断、边际公共资金价值
AI.method: 对82项随机对照试验进行元分析，构建联合似然函数模型，同时纳入已发表和未发表研究（通过试验注册库、资助记录、研究实验室、证据交换所等渠道获取），估计标准误分布、基于显著性的写入概率，并通过估计效应分布刻画文件抽屉问题。
AI.findings: 偏倚校正后的效应量为：考试成绩0.05 SD、成绩0.07 SD、出勤率0.05 SD、入学率0.03 SD；在考试成绩这一识别最佳领域中，统计不显著的结果仍有较高的写入率；大型研究估计的潜在效应更小，表明真实效应与研究精度相关；在较小样本领域，通过锚定绝对写入率可帮助识别选择概率；任何单项研究估计都难以否定干预措施的采纳，因为家长干预的边际公共资金价值较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种联合似然函数方法，同时建模已发表和未发表研究的效应分布，更全面地校正发表偏倚；发现真实效应与研究精度存在相关，挑战了元分析中常见的独立假设；为文件抽屉问题的量化提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者和实践者提供了低成本家长参与干预措施的有效性证据（效应量虽小但稳健）；指出单项研究不足以否定政策采纳，未来研究应聚焦于理解不同情境下的异质性；为资助者和研究者提供了评估额外RCT价值的决策框架。

title: Measuring Housing Quality Using Revealed Preference: A Geographic PageRank Approach
affiliations: Georgia State University - Department of Economics, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Northwestern University

detail.title: Measuring Housing Quality Using Revealed Preference: A Geographic PageRank Approach

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Geographic PageRank (GPR), an innovative measure of place quality that is based on migration decisions, employing a recursive algorithm that leverages the full network of migration flows. Using various public data sources, we construct GPR rankings for U.S. counties and metropolitan areas. We also extend the rankings to capture changes over time and differences for population subgroups, providing a versatile data product. As an application, we show that GPR can serve as an "anti-instrument'' for unobserved housing quality when pricing environmental amenities, recovering a correctly signed implicit price of air pollution that is in line with quasi-experimental benchmarks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于人口迁移决策的地理PageRank（GPR）指标，用于衡量地区质量，并展示了其在环境估值中的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人口迁移网络构建一种衡量地区质量的综合指标，并验证其在环境经济学中的应用价值？
AI.motivation: 传统地区质量指标（如房价、工资）存在内生性和测量误差问题，难以准确分离环境与非环境因素。作者希望利用迁移决策中的显示偏好，构建更可靠的地区质量度量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PageRank算法的递归排序方法；迁移决策显示偏好理论；环境资产定价中的特征价格模型。
AI.method: 利用多种公开数据源，构建美国县级和都市区的GPR排名，并拓展至时间趋势和人口子群体分析；通过环境估值应用验证指标有效性。
AI.findings: GPR可作为未观测住房质量的"反工具变量"，在环境便利设施定价中恢复出符号正确的空气污染隐性价格，与准实验基准结果一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将PageRank算法引入区域质量度量领域，为迁移网络分析提供了新范式；提出GPR作为"反工具变量"解决环境估值中的经典内生性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于迁移行为的地区质量综合排名；为环境经济学家提供了处理住房质量遗漏变量偏误的新工具。

title: Predicting Labor Force Types
affiliations: McGill University - Department of Economics, McGill University, McGill University, McGill University and McGill University

detail.title: Predicting Labor Force Types

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
A small group of people accounts for a large majority of flows between labor market states and of spells in un- and non-employment. In this paper, we ask whether it is possible to identify those weakly attached to the labor market during their prime working-age years using information available early in their lives. First, we use information on labor force transitions between ages 30 and 50 contained in the long panel provided by the NLSY79 to identify those weakly connected to the labor market during their prime age. To do so, we use k-means clustering on moments describing observed spells in employment, unemployment, and non-employment between 30 and 50. This points to a group of less attached individuals who are disproportionally female, less educated, and in poor health. In a second step we predict, using information collected at various points before age 30—which we do not use in clustering—whether individuals will turn out to belong to the weakly attached type in their prime age. We find that information from ages 22 to 29 allows predicting membership of the low-attachment group with high precision. Particularly influential is information on early labor market experiences and health. The fact that we can predict weak and strong labor market attachment during prime working age using variables observed in individuals’ twenties suggests the presence of persistent heterogeneity that shapes labor market experiences throughout the life cycle.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用NLSY79长期面板数据，通过k-means聚类识别出30-50岁期间劳动力市场弱依附群体，并发现22-29岁期间的早期信息（尤其是早期劳动经历和健康状况）能高精度预测该群体的归属，揭示了贯穿生命周期的持久异质性。
AI.research_question: 能否利用个体早年（30岁前）的信息，识别出那些在黄金工作年龄（30-50岁）期间对劳动力市场依附性较弱的群体？
AI.motivation: 少数人群占据了劳动力市场状态之间流动的绝大部分，以及失业和非就业状态中的大部分持续时间。识别这些弱依附群体具有重要的政策意义，但关键在于能否在早期阶段就进行预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场依附性的持久异质性假设；生命周期视角下的劳动力市场经历塑造机制。
AI.method: 两步法：第一步，利用NLSY79面板数据中30-50岁的劳动力转换信息，采用k-means聚类方法识别弱依附群体；第二步，利用30岁前（22-29岁）的信息（未用于聚类）预测个体是否属于弱依附类型。
AI.findings: (1) 存在一个弱依附群体，其特点是女性比例高、教育程度低、健康状况差；(2) 22-29岁期间的信息能高精度预测个体是否属于弱依附群体；(3) 早期劳动力市场经历和健康状况是最具影响力的预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了劳动力市场依附性存在贯穿生命周期的持久异质性，表明早期经历对长期劳动市场结果具有塑造作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期识别劳动力市场风险人群提供了可行方法，有助于政策制定者提前干预，针对性地改善弱依附群体的劳动参与和就业前景。

title: Future-Proofing Authentication Against Insecure Bootstrapping for 5G Networks: Feasibility, Resiliency, and Accountability
affiliations: University of South Florida, Purdue University, University of Texas at Dallas, University of South Florida, University of South Florida and Purdue University

detail.title: Future-Proofing Authentication Against Insecure Bootstrapping for 5G Networks: Feasibility, Resiliency, and Accountability

keywords.keywords: 5G Cellular NetworksAuthenticationNetwork Performance AnalysisTransitional Post-Quantum Security

detail.abstract: The 5G protocol lacks a robust base station (BS) authentication mechanism during the initial bootstrapping phase, leaving it susceptible to fake BSs, spoofed broadcasts, and large-scale manipulation of System Information Blocks (SIBs). Existing solutions incur high communication overhead, rely on centralized trust, and lack accountability and long-term breach resiliency. Given the inevitability of BS compromise and the severe impact of forged SIBs as the root of trust (e.g., fake alerts, tracking, false roaming), distributed trust, verifiable forgery detection, and audit logging are essential yet remain largely unexplored. These challenges are further amplified by the emergence of quantum-capable adversaries. While NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) standards are widely viewed as a path toward long-term security, their feasibility under 5G's strict packet-size, latency, and broadcast constraints has not been systematically studied. This work presents, to our knowledge, the first comprehensive network-level performance characterization of integrating NIST-PQC standards and conventional digital signatures into 5G BS authentication, showing that direct PQC adoption is impractical due to excessive signature sizes, fragmentation, and protocol-level delays. To address these challenges, we propose BORG, a future-proof authentication framework based on a Hierarchical Identity-Based Threshold Signature with Fail-Stop (HITFS) properties. BORG distributes trust across multiple BSs via threshold signing, enables post-mortem verifiable forgery detection, and provides tamper-evident, PQ-secure audit logging, while maintaining compact signatures that fit within a single SIB1 packet without fragmentation and incurring minimal UE overhead, as validated through our real over-the-air 5G testbed implementation.

AI.tldr: 论文指出5G协议在初始引导阶段缺乏基站认证机制，现有方案存在通信开销高、依赖中心化信任、缺乏问责和长期抗量子安全性等问题。作者提出BORG框架，基于分层身份基阈门签名（HITFS），在保持紧凑签名（可放入单个SIB1数据包）的同时，实现分布式信任、可验证伪造检测和抗量子安全审计日志，并通过真实5G测试平台验证。
AI.research_question: 如何在满足5G严格的包大小、延迟和广播约束的前提下，设计一种具备抗量子安全、分布式信任和问责能力的基站认证机制？
AI.motivation: 5G协议缺乏稳健的基站认证机制，易受伪造基站、广播欺骗和SIB大规模操控攻击。现有方案存在通信开销大、依赖中心化信任、缺乏问责和长期漏洞恢复能力。量子计算时代的到来进一步加剧了这些挑战，而NIST后量子密码标准在5G环境下的可行性尚未被系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层身份基阈门签名（Hierarchical Identity-Based Threshold Signature with Fail-Stop, HITFS）
AI.method: 首先对NIST-PQC标准和传统数字签名在5G基站认证中的性能进行首次全面网络级表征；随后提出BORG框架，采用HITFS方案实现分布式信任、可验证伪造检测和抗量子安全审计日志；通过真实5G空中接口测试平台进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 直接采用NIST-PQC标准在5G中不可行，原因是签名过大导致分片和协议级延迟；BORG框架的紧凑签名可容纳在单个SIB1数据包中而无须分片，UE开销极低，并在真实5G测试平台中通过验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统评估NIST后量子密码标准在5G基站认证中的网络级性能瓶颈；提出HITFS方案，结合分层身份基签名、阈门签名与失败停止特性，在抗量子安全下实现分布式信任和可验证伪造检测。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一种面向未来的5G基站认证框架BORG，在满足5G严格约束的前提下实现抗量子安全、分布式信任和审计追溯，适合实际部署。
